title: High-End Personal Brand Video Editor — YouTube + Instagram
description:
# High-End Personal Brand Video Editor — YouTube + Instagram Reels



## The Opportunity



I'm looking for an **exceptionally talented and ambitious video editor** to join me long-term in building a high-end personal brand in the business, mindset, performance, identity, and personal-development space.



This is NOT a generic video-editing position.



I'm looking for someone who understands how the world's strongest personal brands package ideas through:



**Storytelling. Psychology. Emotion. Pacing. Hooks. Typography. Personal B-roll. Sound design. Visual identity.**



Think of the quality, retention, storytelling, and attention to detail found in creators such as:



* Iman Gadzhi

* Alex Hormozi

* Nick Setting

* SooWei Goh



The objective isn't to copy these creators.



It's to understand **why their content works** and develop our own recognizable, premium visual identity.



I don't want unnecessary effects every two seconds.



I want content that feels:



**Premium. Clean. Modern. Powerful. Emotional. Intelligent. High-value.**



Most importantly, the ideas themselves must remain at the center.



---



# Before Applying — Study the Brand



Before applying, please take some time to understand the content we're building:



**YouTube:** Hugo Christiansen 







I strongly recommend watching some of my content before submitting your application.



I don't want someone who simply knows how to edit videos.



I want someone who understands **my ideas, personality, audience, communication style, and long-term vision** — and who can eventually translate all of that into a recognizable visual identity.



If you've already been following my content before seeing this job post, please mention it in your application.



---



# What We're Building



This isn't about hiring someone to "edit some videos."



I'm building a serious personal brand and content ecosystem with the intention of becoming a major player in the business, mindset, identity, performance, and personal-development industry.



I'm looking for someone with an **insane amount of grit**.



Someone ambitious.



Someone curious.



Someone who wants responsibility.



Someone who wants to become world-class at their craft.



Someone who gets excited about building something from the early stages and eventually being able to say:



**"I helped build that."**



I want the type of person I'd genuinely enjoy sitting down and having dinner with — someone who thinks differently, cares deeply about what they create, and has ambitions far beyond simply collecting a paycheck.



If you're looking for a comfortable freelance gig where you receive footage, edit it, send it back, and forget about it...



**This probably isn't for you.**



But if you want to become an integral part of an ambitious brand and grow as the company grows, keep reading.



---



# What You'll Be Editing



We plan to publish approximately:



## YouTube



**2+ long-form YouTube videos per week**



## Instagram



**Approximately 2 Reels per day**



Most Reels will initially come from long-form content, alongside occasional original short-form content.



One of your most important responsibilities will be watching long-form videos and **independently recognizing the moments that deserve to become short-form content.**



I don't want to provide every timestamp forever.



You should eventually be able to watch a video and think:



**"THAT is the Reel."**



And understand exactly why.



---



# This Is About More Than Editing



Technical editing ability is obviously important.



But I'm equally interested in your understanding of **human psychology and emotion.**



A great editor doesn't simply make a video look pretty.



A great editor understands:



**What makes someone stop scrolling?**



**What creates curiosity?**



**Where does tension need to build?**



**Where should we slow down?**



**What moment creates emotion?**



**What makes the viewer trust the creator?**



**What makes an idea memorable?**



**What makes the right viewer eventually want to work with us?**



Our audience consists primarily of **successful founders and entrepreneurs who have already achieved significant results but know there is another level of performance, identity, and personal transformation available to them.**



We're not trying to attract everybody.



We're trying to create content that resonates deeply with the **right people**.



Views matter.



But **qualified attention, trust, the right audience, and ultimately conversions matter more.**



---



# Your Responsibilities



## Long-Form YouTube



* Turn raw footage into polished, premium YouTube videos

* Remove unnecessary pauses, repetition, mistakes, and dead space

* Improve pacing and viewer retention

* Create emotional dynamics throughout the video

* Use my personal B-roll and brand assets where appropriate

* Add tasteful graphics, text, screenshots, diagrams, and visual explanations

* Use music and sound design intelligently

* Maintain a consistent premium visual identity

* Make complex ideas easier to understand visually

* Understand when NOT to add an effect

* Help make every video feel intentional



## Short-Form Content



You will watch long-form videos and independently identify the strongest short-form opportunities.



You'll then:



* Select powerful 30–90 second sections

* Identify or construct strong opening hooks

* Package ideas specifically for short-form consumption

* Reframe footage vertically

* Add premium captions and typography

* Use my personal B-roll for visual storytelling

* Create tasteful pattern interrupts

* Improve pacing and retention

* Use sound design intelligently

* Amplify emotion without making the content feel artificial



You must understand the difference between **cutting a clip** and **packaging an idea.**



---



# Personal B-Roll & Content Library



You will have access to an organized **content bank containing my personal B-roll, lifestyle footage, previous shoots, photos, screenshots, graphics, and other brand assets.**



When adding B-roll, I want you to primarily use **my own footage and brand assets — NOT generic stock footage from the internet.**



Part of your job will be learning this content library extremely well so that when I discuss a particular idea, emotion, experience, or story, you instinctively know which visual moments from my life can reinforce it.



Over time, we'll continuously expand this library with new footage from professional shoots, travel, business, lifestyle, and everyday life.



The goal is for the content to visually communicate **my world and my brand**, rather than looking like generic internet content.



---



# Data & Content Performance



Over time, I want you to become obsessed with understanding **why certain content performs better than other content.**



Not just:



**"This Reel got more views."**



But:



**Why?**



What was the topic?



What was the hook?



What emotion did it create?



What editing choices worked?



What type of person engaged with it?



Did it generate the right followers?



Did it generate qualified conversations?



Did it ultimately contribute to sales?



We'll analyze our content and continuously improve.



The objective isn't simply **maximum views**.



The objective is building a content machine that generates:



**Attention ? Emotion ? Trust ? Authority ? Qualified Audience ? Conversion**



If analyzing that sounds exciting to you, you'll probably enjoy working with us.



---



# The Person We're Looking For



Formal education does NOT matter to me.



I don't care whether you have a bachelor's degree.



I care about:



**Taste.

Grit.

Ambition.

Creativity.

Emotional intelligence.

Psychology.

Content judgment.

English comprehension.

Reliability.

Attention to detail.

Editing ability.

Speed.

Curiosity.

Coachability.**



Ideally, you've already spent **tens or hundreds of hours consuming YouTube content about business, entrepreneurship, personal development, psychology, performance, or high-level personal brands.**



If you've spent hundreds of hours studying creators, businesses, personal brands, storytelling, and psychology because you genuinely enjoy this world, that's a major advantage.



When someone references creators like Hormozi or Gadzhi, I don't want you completely unfamiliar with the world we're operating in.



You should understand internet culture.



You should understand personal brands.



You should understand why people watch.



And your English needs to be strong enough to understand nuanced conversations about business, psychology, identity, performance, and personal development.



---



# The Long-Term Vision



I'm specifically looking for someone who wants to build a **long-term relationship**.



This starts as a Video Editor position.



But for the right person, there is a real potential progression:



**Video Editor ? Senior Editor ? Content Strategist ? Head of Content / Creative Director**



I would love to eventually find someone capable of becoming much more than an editor.



Someone who understands the brand so deeply that they can help:



* Develop content concepts

* Analyze content and conversion performance

* Plan videos

* Identify winning topics

* Create storytelling frameworks

* Coordinate the content production process

* Direct other editors

* Work alongside videographers

* Shape the visual identity of the brand

* Identify gaps in our personal B-roll/content library

* Help determine what we should create next



As the brand grows, **your compensation and responsibility can grow with it.**



Although this position begins remotely, exceptional long-term team members may eventually have opportunities to work together in person — potentially joining shoots, projects, or team trips in places such as **Paris, Marbella, Dubai, and elsewhere.**



I want to build a small group of extremely capable, ambitious people who genuinely enjoy working together and want to build something significant.



---



# How to Apply



Read this carefully.



**Start your application with the word "OMEGA".**



If your application doesn't begin with OMEGA, I'll assume you didn't read the job description.



Then send me ONLY the following:



## 1. Your 3 Best Short-Form Edits



Send the **three best Reels/Shorts you've ever edited.**



Not 30.



Your three best.



## 2. Your Best Long-Form YouTube Edit



Send the **single best long-form YouTube video you've edited.**



## 3. Your Rate & Availability



Tell me:



* Your preferred hourly rate

* Your preferred monthly rate

* Approximately how many hours per week you can dedicate



## 4. Your Creative Taste



Name **three creators whose content/editing you admire** and briefly explain why.



## 5. Your Experience With This World



Tell me what business, entrepreneurship, psychology, performance, or personal-development content you personally consume.



I genuinely want to know.



## 6. Your Contribution



For every portfolio example, tell me what YOU personally did:



* Editing

* Clip selection

* Personal B-roll selection

* Motion graphics

* Captions

* Sound design

* Hook creation

* Storytelling

* Thumbnail/design



Don't claim an entire team's work as your own.



## 7. One Thing You Would Improve



After looking at my YouTube and Instagram, tell me **one thing you would immediately improve about my current content or editing.**



Don't tell me what you think I want to hear.



I want to understand **how you think creatively.**



---



# Selection Process



If I like your portfolio, I'll send you footage from one of my videos.



Before you even edit it, I may ask you to:



1. Find the three strongest potential Reels

2. Give me their timestamps

3. Create a potential hook/title for each

4. Explain WHY you selected them



This tests something I care deeply about:



**How you think.**



Final candidates may then receive a **paid editing test**.



You'll be evaluated on both technical execution and creative judgment.



---



# Compensation



I'm initially looking around the **$5–$7/hour range**, depending on skill, experience, speed, and portfolio.



I'm also open to fixed monthly arrangements.



If your rate is slightly outside this range but you believe you're exceptional, **apply anyway.**



If you become extremely valuable to the brand, I'm happy for your compensation to reflect that.



I'm not looking for the cheapest editor.



**I'm looking for someone currently undervalued who has the ambition to become world-class.**



If you're hungry, extremely ambitious, obsessed with improving your craft, and excited by the idea of helping build a brand from the ground up into something significant, I want to hear from you.



If you read this and thought:



**"This sounds exactly like me."**



Start your application with:



**OMEGA**

title: Full-Time WFH Client Success Manager — $2,000 Base + Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here:



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

.

Previous experience working in healthcare, wellness, aesthetics, medical clinics or similar.

Experience handling medical/healthcare administration.

Extremely organised

Professional and trustworthy

You should be the type of person who sees something outstanding on a spreadsheet or calendar and follows it up without needing to be reminded.

title: Full-Time (Meta Ads) Media Buyer
description:
We are looking for an experienced full-time Meta Ads Media Buyer to join our performance marketing team.



This is an execution-focused role. You will work under our Media Buying Manager and execute our existing strategies, structures, testing methods, and scaling processes.



We are not looking for someone who wants to completely reinvent our strategy. We already have established systems and processes. Your responsibility is to execute them accurately, keep everything running, and optimize campaigns based on our guidelines and data.



Your Responsibilities

- Manage and monitor multiple Meta Ads accounts daily

- Execute our existing media buying strategy across different platforms

- Launch, monitor, optimize, and scale campaigns according to our processes

- Upload new creatives, copy, and campaigns based on provided instructions

- Ensure campaigns and ad accounts remain operational

- Quickly identify rejected ads, disabled campaigns, account issues, or other problems

- Communicate directly with our advertising agencies and account providers when issues occur

- Take immediate action when campaigns or accounts go down

- Monitor campaign performance and make adjustments based on our KPIs

- Work closely with our creative team and Media Buying Manager

- Maintain clear reporting and communication through Slack



Requirements

- Minimum 3 years of proven experience with Meta Ads

- Strong experience managing and optimizing paid social campaigns

- Experience managing multiple ad accounts simultaneously

- Experience with tracking, attribution, pixels, CAPI, and third-party tracking platforms

- Good understanding of Meta Ads account structures and troubleshooting

- Strong written and spoken English

- Excellent communication skills

- Comfortable working as part of a team through Slack

- Able to follow established strategies and processes accurately

- Proactive and highly responsive when problems occur

- Able to provide clear proof of previous Meta Ads experience and results



Very Important



This is not a 9-to-5 position.



We don't expect you to work 24/7, but our advertising campaigns are a critical part of our business. If an account or campaign goes down, we expect you to take ownership and help get everything back online as quickly as possible — including outside normal working hours or during weekends when necessary.



We need someone who thinks:



"Something is down — how do we get it live again ASAP?"



Not:



"My working day is finished, I'll look at it tomorrow."





You will be joining an existing team under a manager, so teamwork and communication are extremely important.



Application



Please include:



- Your years of Meta Ads experience

- Examples of accounts/campaigns you have managed

- Approximate monthly ad spend you have managed

- Experience with Hyros, WeTracked, CAPI, or similar tracking solutions

- Experience managing multiple ad accounts

- Your availability

- Your current location/time zone

- Examples or proof of previous results



Applications without demonstrable Meta Ads experience will not be considered.

The ideal candidate will have 5+ years of experience as a PA or Sales Assistant, with exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work across multiple priorities in a fast-paced, client-facing environment. You will be well-presented, self-motivated, and capable of working independently while supporting a team of sales and charter brokers managing complex transactions. Experience in the yachting industry is strongly preferred.



**Job Responsibilities:**

- Assist sales and charter brokers in creating presentations and itineraries.

- Support the team with day-to-day activities and client inquiries.

- Prepare contract details and work on contracts for various sales departments.

- Draft letters, review documents and materials for accuracy and compliance.

- Compile monthly Sales & Charter updates and reports.

- Set up mailings and client communications as directed.

- Maintain and upkeep company databases for accuracy and completeness.

- Order and stock the charter department with necessary stationary and housekeeping products.

**Qualifications:**

- Minimum 5+ years of experience as a PA or Sales Assistant.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills.

- Self-motivated and self-driven with ability to work on own initiative.

- Ability to think ahead and anticipate needs before they arise.

- Excellent organization and time management skills.

- Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality at all times.

- Ability to work for different people simultaneously, prioritize, and multi-task.

- Well-presented and businesslike demeanor.

- Advanced problem-solving skills.

- Working knowledge of yachting MLS systems and tools.

- Experience in the yachting industry is strongly preferred.

- Multilingual capabilities are a plus.

**Requirements:**

- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

title: Virtual Assistant for Renovation Operations
description:
We’re looking for a sharp, proactive, and highly organised Renovation Operations Virtual Assistant to support the renovation lead of a fast-moving property investment and renovation business based in regional Australia.



Our renovation lead currently oversees more than 20 active renovation projects. His workday is fast-moving and often shaped by what is happening on-site, including trade availability, materials, property access, urgent repairs, payments, compliance requirements, and changing project priorities.



Your role will be to bring structure and follow-through to this workload. You will help turn calls, voice messages,
s, photos, videos, and brief instructions into clearly organised tasks—and then ensure those tasks continue moving until they are completed.



This is not a traditional inbox-and-calendar Executive Assistant role. It is a hands-on coordination and operations position for someone who can work quickly, use practical judgement, follow up confidently, and take ownership without needing constant supervision.



The position will begin part-time, with the potential to develop into a full-time role for the right person.



What you’ll be doing

- Managing renovation tasks, deadlines, notes, and follow-ups in ClickUp

- Turning
s, calls, voice messages, photos, and site updates into clear action items

- Monitoring projects and identifying urgent tasks, blockers, and missing information

- Preparing and updating scopes of work and trade job briefs

- Following up with trades, contractors, suppliers, and other parties

- Sourcing trades in regional Australian areas

- Maintaining contractor details, quotes, waivers, access information, and property records

- Assisting with preliminary costing, quantities, or estimating where appropriate

- Researching Australian rental, safety, and property-compliance requirements

- Preparing concise project updates covering progress, blockers, and next steps

- Creating practical checklists, templates, and SOPs

- Communicating delays early and providing clear completion estimates



Who we’re looking for

You may be a strong fit if you:

- Have experience in construction, renovation, property maintenance, project coordination, or operations support

- Work quickly without sacrificing accuracy

- Can organise incomplete or fast-moving information into clear next steps

- Take ownership and follow tasks through without repeated reminders

- Are confident following up with trades, contractors, and suppliers

- Can manage multiple projects and competing priorities

- Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

- Provide timely updates and raise blockers early

- Respond well to feedback and adapt quickly

- Are comfortable using ClickUp, Google Workspace, spreadsheets, and online document-management tools

- Can accurately track your working time

- Have reliable internet, a suitable workspace, and consistent availability



Highly regarded experience

Experience in any of the following would be an advantage:

- Residential construction or renovation

- Construction estimating or quantity surveying

- Architecture, interior design, or civil engineering

- Preparing scopes of work, job briefs, or cost estimates

- Reading property plans, inspection reports, and site documentation

- Sourcing and coordinating trades in Australia

- Australian building, rental, or property-compliance requirements



Relevant building, renovation, or estimating experience is preferred. We will also consider fast learners with strong initiative, practical judgement, and a genuine interest in renovation operations.



HOW TO APPLY

Please submit the following:

- A 2–3 minute Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you would be a strong fit for the role.

- Attach a copy of your most recent and updated CV.

- Share an example of a time you took ownership of a task or problem without being given detailed instructions.

- Confirm your current availability and preferred working hours in Melbourne time.



Applications without a Loom video and updated CV will not be considered. Please speak naturally in your video rather than reading from a prepared script.

title: Lead Generation & Appointment Setter
description:
# Lead Generation & Appointment Setter



**Company:** Limitless Credit

**Position:** Part-Time Lead Generation & Appointment Setter

**Starting Hours:** 10–15 hours per week



## About the Role



Limitless Credit is looking for a proactive Lead Generation & Appointment Setter to help us generate more qualified leads and conversations.



Your primary job is simple: **find potential clients and referral partners, start conversations, follow up consistently, and create opportunities for the company.**



We are looking for someone who is comfortable with outreach and does not need to wait for leads to come in.



## Responsibilities



* Generate new leads through outbound outreach

* Reach out to potential referral partners such as loan officers and real estate professionals

* Start conversations through social media,
, text, or phone

* Follow up with new and old leads

* Reactivate leads already inside our CRM

* Qualify potential clients

* Schedule qualified appointments when necessary

* Keep leads organized and updated inside GHL

* Track outreach, responses, leads generated, and appointments

* Follow company scripts and SOPs

* Report results weekly



## What We're Looking For



* Previous lead generation or appointment-setting experience

* Strong written and spoken English

* Comfortable calling and messaging prospects

* Persistent without being pushy

* Organized and able to follow up consistently

* Experience with GoHighLevel is a plus

* Experience working with credit, mortgage, real estate, financial services, or agencies is a plus

* Able to work independently and be measured by results



## How Success Will Be Measured



We care about results, not just hours worked.



Your performance will be measured by:



* Outreach completed

* Conversations started

* Qualified leads generated

* Referral partners contacted

* Follow-ups completed

title: INBOUND APPOINTMENT SETTER — HAIR SALON (WARM FACEBOOK/INSTAGRAM LEADS, $1,250–$2,000/MO OTE + 13TH MONTH PAY)
description:
READ THIS FIRST



We're hiring ONE full-time Inbound Appointment Setter to call warm leads from our
 and Instagram ad campaigns for a color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California.



This is NOT cold calling. Every lead you speak to has already raised their hand by submitting their info through one of our ads. Your job is to reach them fast, build trust quickly, understand what they actually want, and guide them into a booked appointment.



This role demands two things at once: sharp conversational judgment AND tight process discipline. The conversations are where you win or lose the booking. The process — cadences, call dispositions, CRM hygiene, follow-up tasks — is what makes the whole system work and what lets us measure anything. You need both. People who are great at one and sloppy at the other don't last here.



On the conversation side, what we're really hiring for is the ability to think on your feet. Someone replies three days later with just "sorry, been busy." Someone says they want highlights but describes something else entirely. Someone says "that's a bit far for me" but what they really mean is they don't see why it's worth the drive. If you can read what people actually mean and move the conversation forward without being told what to say next, you'll do well here.



If you need to be spoon-fed a script for every situation, this won't work.



IF YOUR BACKGROUND IS PRIMARILY CUSTOMER SERVICE OR VIRTUAL ASSISTANT AND NOT SALES, PLEASE DO NOT APPLY.



OTE: $1,250–$2,000/month (base $900–$1,000 + uncapped performance bonuses).

13th month pay included — paid every December, on top of your base. Not baked in. Not restructured. A full extra month of base pay, added on top.



---



ABOUT THE COMPANY



You'll be employed by Midnight Siren, a growth and client acquisition company that operates and supports beauty service businesses. Your day-to-day work focuses on a family-owned, color-specialist hair salon in Fontana, California that has served the Inland Empire for over 21 years.



The salon has 4.9 stars on Google with 200+ reviews and a stylist team with 75+ combined years of experience. The business is real, established, and respected in its market.



You'll work directly under Ethan, the founder of Midnight Siren — no middle managers, no agency layers between you and the person making decisions. The Midnight Siren team is small and tightly focused. The stylists at salon handle the in-salon experience; you and Ethan handle everything that gets a client booked.



A note on team structure: you will be the only appointment setter on the team. Your day-to-day working relationship is directly with Ethan. There are no peer-level coworkers, no team chat with other appointment setters, no group energy to feed off. If you thrive with autonomy, clear systems, and a direct manager relationship, this works well. If you need a team environment or peer social dynamic to stay motivated, this will feel isolating over time.



We're in an active scaling phase. Core processes exist and are being refined. They don't change daily, but they evolve as we learn. If you like improving systems alongside a team, you'll fit. If you want a fully crystallized corporate environment where nothing ever shifts, you won't.



---



WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY BE DOING



This is a front-line revenue role, not customer support.



Daily:



- Call new
/Instagram ad leads within minutes of opt-in (speed matters — you'll have task notifications throughout the day)

- Run our call script for the structured parts of the call, and use our frameworks + your own judgment for discovery and objection handling. The script covers the greeting, the offer, pricing, and the booking ask. Discovery can't be fully scripted — clients say what they say, and you'll need to adapt in real time.

- Respond to inbound SMS,
 
, and Instagram DMs that get escalated to a human when our AI can't handle them

- Collect cards on file via secure link (never over the phone), book appointments, reschedule, and cancel

- Call no-shows to get them back on the calendar

- Coordinate with stylists about client requests and scheduling needs

- Create follow-up tasks in HighLevel (our CRM)

- Submit a brief end-of-day report with your numbers



Weekly:



- One coaching/review call with Ethan (~30–45 min)

- Async coaching via Loom video reviews on your live call recordings between meetings

- Review your KPIs, own your numbers, and bring data-backed ideas to improve them



During training (first 2–4 weeks):



We'll meet daily for live coaching to get you fully ramped before transitioning to the weekly + async cadence.



---



A WORD ON THE CALL SCRIPT (READ CAREFULLY)



We use a script. We also need you to think.



Where the script is fixed: the greeting, how we introduce the salon, how we present the offer, how we state pricing, the booking ask, and our core objection responses. These are tested and they work. You run them as written. Your tone, warmth, and pacing are what make them sound human — not changing the words.



Where the script can't help you: everything a real client throws at you. A vague text with no context. A client describing a service using the wrong name. Someone who's hesitant but won't say why. Someone who asks about price before you've figured out what they actually want. There is no script for these. There's a framework, and there's your judgment.



This is the part people underestimate. A big chunk of this job is not reciting — it's listening to what someone actually means and figuring out the next move in seconds, while they're on the phone with you.



Scripts do change here, but only based on data. If you bring an idea for a better line, we'll A/B test it. If it wins, it becomes the script. What we don't do is let setters freelance changes on the fly, because then we can't measure what works.



If you want to be told exactly what to say in every situation, this role will frustrate you. If you like having strong structure AND room to think, you'll do well.



---



SCHEDULE (PACIFIC TIME — GRAVEYARD SHIFT IN PHILIPPINES)



All schedule references in this post are in US Pacific Time. Because PH is 15-16 hours ahead of California, each shift starts late at night your time and ends the following morning.

- US workdays: Monday through Friday

- US days off: Saturday and Sunday

- Hours per day: 8 hours of work + 1 hour of break (30 min lunch + 2× 15 min breaks, or 30 min lunch + 1× 30 min break — your call)

- Pacific Time (US): 7:45 AM – 4:45 PM PST



Philippine Time during US Standard Time (roughly November through mid-March):



Shift runs 11:45 PM – 8:45 AM PHT

- A US Monday shift = late Monday night through Tuesday morning your time

- A US Friday shift = late Friday night through Saturday morning your time

- Your days off in PH local time: Sunday and Monday (until your shift starts late Monday night)



Philippine Time during US Daylight Savings Time (roughly mid-March through early November):

title: Product Category Manager
description:
PRODUCT CATEGORY MANAGER



Company: EVORETRO

Department:Product & Commercial Operations

Employment Type:Full-Time



 POSITION SUMMARY:



The Product Category Manager is responsible for managing and growing assigned product categories from assortment planning and product development through launch, sales performance, inventory management, and continuous optimization.



This role will work cross-functionally with Product Development, Sales, Marketing, Marketplace, Customer Service, and Supply Chain to ensure that each product category meets customer needs, achieves sales targets, maintains healthy inventory levels, and contributes to overall business growth.



The ideal candidate is highly analytical, commercially minded, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced e-commerce and collectibles environment.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:



1. Category Strategy & Planning

• Develop and execute category strategies aligned with company goals.

•  Analyze category performance, sales trends, customer demand, and market opportunities.

•  Identify opportunities for category expansion, new products, and product improvements.

•  Maintain a balanced and competitive product assortment.

• Monitor competitor products, pricing, positioning, and market trends.



2. Product Assortment & Product Lifecycle



• Manage the product lifecycle from concept and development through launch, growth, and phase-out.

•  Evaluate existing products and recommend which products should be expanded, improved, repositioned, or discontinued.

•  Work closely with Product Development to identify and prioritize new product opportunities.

• Ensure product information, specifications, pricing, images, and other required assets are complete and accurate.



3. Sales & Category Performance



• Monitor sales performance by SKU, product, and category.

• Track revenue, units sold, margins, conversion, and other relevant KPIs.

• Identify underperforming products and develop corrective action plans.

• Recommend pricing, promotions, bundles, and merchandising strategies to improve performance.

• Work with Sales and Marketing to maximize product visibility and revenue.



4. Inventory & Forecasting



•  Collaborate with Supply Chain and Operations to maintain appropriate inventory levels.

• Monitor inventory movement, sell-through, stock levels, and potential stockouts.

• Provide input into demand forecasting and purchasing decisions.

• Identify slow-moving and excess inventory and recommend appropriate actions.

• Coordinate product launches with inventory availability.



5. Product Launch Management



•  Coordinate new product launches across relevant teams.

• Develop launch timelines, priorities, and required deliverables.

•  Ensure products are ready for launch across e-commerce and marketplace channels.

•  Coordinate with Marketing regarding launch campaigns, promotions, content, and product positioning.

•  Monitor post-launch performance and recommend adjustments.



 6. Marketplace & E-Commerce Optimization



• Work with the Marketplace and E-Commerce teams to optimize product listings.

•  Review product titles, descriptions, images, keywords, pricing, and merchandising.

•  Identify opportunities to improve conversion and product discoverability.

•  Monitor category performance across relevant sales channels.



 7. Customer & Market Insights



•  Analyze customer feedback, reviews, inquiries, and purchasing behavior.

•  Identify recurring customer needs and product gaps.

• Translate customer insights into product and category recommendations.

• Work with Customer Service to identify product-related issues and opportunities for improvement.



8. Cross-Functional Collaboration



• Act as the primary category point of contact across Product, Sales, Marketing, Marketplace, Customer Service, and Supply Chain.

• Ensure teams are aligned on category priorities and upcoming launches.

• Maintain clear documentation, timelines, and category plans.

• Communicate category performance and key issues to management.



KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs)



The Product Category Manager may be evaluated based on:

• Category revenue growth

• Category gross margin

• Sales and unit growth

• SKU/product performance

• Product sell-through rate

• Inventory turnover

•  Stockout and excess inventory levels

•  New product launch performance

•  Product conversion rate

•  Product listing quality and completeness

•  Number and quality of new product opportunities identified

• Achievement of category sales targets

•  Customer feedback and product issue resolution



 QUALIFICATIONS



• Bahelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, E-Commerce, Product Management, or a related field preferred.

• 2–5+ years of experience** in category management, product management, e-commerce, merchandising, sales operations, or a related role.

• Experience managing product categories, SKUs, or product portfolios.

•  Strong understanding of e-commerce and marketplace operations.

•  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Experience working with sales and inventory data.

•  Strong organizational and project management skills.

•  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.



 PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:



Experience in any of the following industries is highly preferred:



• Collectibles

•  Trading Card Games (TCG)

•  Pokémon or other hobby products

•  Gaming

•  Toys

•  E-commerce

• Consumer products

•  Product protection/accessories

•  Marketplace businesses



CORE COMPETENCIES:



• Category Strategy

•  Product Management

•  Commercial Analysis

•  E-Commerce

•  Sales & Revenue Growth

•  Inventory Management

•  Product Lifecycle Management

•  Market Research

•  Data Analysis

•  Project Management

•  Cross-Functional Collaboration

•  Problem Solving

•  Commercial Decision-Making



ROLE EXPECTATION:



The Product Category Manager is expected to take end-to-end ownership of assigned product categories, ensuring that products are properly planned, launched, marketed, sold, stocked, evaluated, and continuously improved.



The role is not limited to monitoring sales. The successful candidate should proactively identify what products the company should sell, how the category should grow, what is underperforming, what customers want next, and what actions should be taken to improve overall category profitability and performance.

title: Operations Coordinator – Australian Plumbing Business
description:
# Operations Coordinator – Australian Plumbing Business



Employment Type: Full-time, long-term

Location: Remote – Philippines

Hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday

Working Hours: 8:00 am–5:00 pm Sydney time



About Us



We are an established Australian plumbing and pipe-relining business servicing commercial, government, aged-care and residential customers across Sydney and regional New South Wales.



Our services include plumbing maintenance, blocked drains, pipe relining, hot-water systems, gas services, emergency repairs and commercial preventative maintenance.



We are looking for an experienced Operations Coordinator who can take ownership of the daily workflow of our plumbing team. This is not a basic data-entry or general virtual assistant position. You will be responsible for helping jobs move smoothly from the initial customer enquiry through scheduling, completion, invoicing and follow-up.



About the Role



You will be the central point of coordination between our customers, plumbers, supervisors, suppliers and management team.



Your responsibility is to keep the schedule organised, ensure plumbers have the information they need, keep customers updated and prevent jobs, quotes and invoices from being forgotten or delayed.



You must be comfortable answering Australian customer phone calls, making decisions, resolving scheduling problems and following tasks through until they are completely closed.



Key Responsibilities



Customer Service and Phone Coordination



* Answer incoming telephone calls professionally and confidently.

* Identify urgent plumbing problems and escalate emergencies appropriately.

* Book appointments and clearly explain attendance arrangements to customers.

* Make outbound calls to confirm appointments, site access and job requirements.

* Keep customers informed about delays, schedule changes and outstanding work.

* Handle customer concerns calmly and professionally.

* Complete follow-up and customer satisfaction calls after work is completed.



Job Creation and Administration



* Monitor shared
 inboxes throughout the day.

* Create accurate jobs in our job-management system from
s, work orders and telephone enquiries.

* Record complete customer, site, contact, purchase-order and scope information.

* Review incoming work orders and identify missing or unclear information.

* Upload documents, photographs, customer
s and supporting information to the correct job.

* Maintain accurate job statuses and notes.



Scheduling and Dispatch



* Schedule and allocate work based on urgency, location, plumber availability, qualifications and required skills.

* Build efficient schedules that reduce unnecessary travel and downtime.

* Confirm site contacts, access instructions, parking requirements and appointment times.

* Ensure plumbers receive complete job information before attending.

* Monitor jobs throughout the day and respond quickly to delays, cancellations, emergencies and access problems.

* Reschedule incomplete jobs and return visits promptly.

* Prepare and confirm the following day’s schedule.



Job Completion and Invoicing Support



* Review completed jobs for plumber notes, photographs, materials and required documentation.

* Follow up field staff when information is missing.

* Ensure completed jobs are ready for invoicing within 24 hours.

* Identify jobs that cannot be invoiced and follow them through until the issue is resolved.

* Monitor outstanding work orders, incomplete jobs and return visits.

* Assist with purchase orders, supplier information and customer documentation when required.



Quotes and Customer Follow-Up



* Prepare or assist with plumbing quotes using established templates and pricing.

* Follow up customers after quotes have been issued.

* Record quote outcomes and future follow-up dates.

* Escalate valuable sales opportunities to management.

* Help convert approved quotes into scheduled work.

* Maintain accurate records of accepted, declined and outstanding quotes.



### Operational Reporting



* Provide a daily summary of urgent jobs, unallocated work, outstanding quotes and jobs awaiting invoicing.

* Monitor scheduling gaps, overdue tasks and customer follow-ups.

* Identify recurring problems and recommend practical process improvements.

* Assist with maintaining procedures, checklists and templates.

* Help management improve plumber productivity, customer service and job turnaround times.



Required Experience and Skills



To be considered, you should have:



* At least two years of experience in operations coordination, service coordination, scheduling or dispatch.

* Previous experience supporting an Australian, New Zealand, UK or US business.

* Excellent spoken and written English.

* Confidence speaking with Australian customers by telephone.

* Experience coordinating field technicians, tradespeople or mobile service teams.

* Strong scheduling, prioritisation and problem-solving skills.

* The ability to manage urgent changes without losing accuracy.

* Strong attention to detail when entering job and customer information.

* The ability to work independently and make sensible operational decisions.

* A strong sense of ownership and a habit of following tasks through to completion.

* Experience using job-management software, CRM systems, Gmail, Google Workspace and spreadsheets.



Experience in plumbing, electrical, HVAC, construction, property maintenance or another field-service business will be highly regarded.



Experience with **Simpro** or similar software such as ServiceM8, Ascora, AroFlo, Tradify or Fergus will be highly regarded.



Technology Requirements



You must have:



* A modern and reliable computer.

* A minimum of 16 GB RAM preferred.

* A professional USB or noise-cancelling headset.

* A quiet and dedicated home workspace.

* Reliable high-speed internet.

* Backup internet through mobile data or another provider.

* A backup plan for power interruptions.

* The ability to work consistently during Sydney business hours.



The Person We Are Looking For



You will suit this position if you:



* Take responsibility instead of waiting to be reminded.

* Communicate problems early.

* Remain calm when the schedule changes.

* Understand that incomplete tasks must be followed through.

* Can confidently speak with customers and field staff.

* Look for practical solutions rather than excuses.

* Care about accuracy, response times and customer service.

* Want a stable, long-term position with one business.

* Are interested in developing into a senior operations role.



What We Offer



* A stable, full-time and long-term position.

* Competitive salary based on demonstrated experience.

* Direct involvement in the operations of an established Australian business.

* Training in our systems, procedures and plumbing services.

* Regular performance and salary reviews.

* Opportunity to grow into a senior coordination or operations-management position.

* A supportive team that values accountability, communication and continuous improvement.



How to Apply



Please submit the following:



1. Your current résumé.

2. A brief cover letter explaining your relevant operations or scheduling experience.

3. A two-minute video or voice recording introducing yourself and describing a difficult scheduling or customer-service problem you have resolved.

4. Details of any Australian businesses you have previously supported.

5. A list of the job-management and CRM systems you have used.

6. Your current internet speed-test result.

7. Details of your computer, monitors, headset, backup internet and backup power arrangements.

8. Your expected monthly salary in US Dollars.

9. Your earliest available starting date.





Screening Questions



Please answer these questions in your application:



1. How many field technicians or tradespeople have you previously coordinated?

2. What factors do you consider when allocating jobs to technicians?

3. How would you handle an urgent customer when every plumber is already booked?

4. What would you do if a plumber completed a job without supplying notes or photographs?

5. What job-management systems have you used?

6. Are you comfortable answering Australian customer calls throughout your shift?

7. Can you work 8:00 am–5:00 pm Sydney time, including the changes caused by Australian daylight saving?

8. Why are you looking for a long-term position with one employer?

title: Meta Ads Media Buyer / Campaign Manager – Dropshipping
description:
We are looking for an experienced Meta Ads Media Buyer / Campaign Manager to join our growing dropshipping team.



This is a hands-on operational role. You will be responsible for the daily management, monitoring and execution of our Meta advertising campaigns across multiple ad accounts and products.



We already have established testing and scaling rules. We are not looking for someone to reinvent our system. We need someone who understands Meta Ads, can follow our SOPs precisely and knows how to make sense of campaign data.



The long-term goal is for the right person to take increasing ownership of our Meta advertising operations.



Your Daily Responsibilities

1. Campaign Setup & Launch Control



You will manage campaigns according to our internal sheets, schedules and SOPs.



Your responsibilities include:



Setting up campaigns in the correct Ad Accounts

Uploading ads correctly

Checking campaign settings before launch

Verifying links, creatives, budgets and tracking

Making sure campaigns and ads remain active and approved

Identifying rejected, disabled or problematic ads before launch

Making sure scheduled tests actually launch on time



Campaigns must not simply be uploaded and forgotten. You are responsible for making sure they are ready and running when they are supposed to be.



2. Daily Campaign Monitoring



Once campaigns are live, you will monitor their performance throughout the testing and scaling process.



We have defined testing rules and KPIs that determine what actions should be taken.



You will:



Monitor active tests

Follow our testing rules and SOPs

Kill underperforming campaigns/ads according to our rules

Scale campaigns that meet our criteria

Monitor existing scaling campaigns

Identify unusual performance or delivery issues

Escalate situations that fall outside our existing rules



Initially, important decisions will be coordinated with the founder. As you demonstrate strong judgment and consistency, you will receive more decision-making responsibility.



3. Performance Data & Reporting



You need to understand the numbers behind Meta advertising.



You should be comfortable analyzing metrics such as:



Spend

Revenue

ROAS

CPA / Cost per Purchase

CPM

CTR

CPC

Conversion Rate

Add to Cart / Checkout / Purchase data

Break-even targets



You will maintain our tracking sheets and ensure campaign data is documented accurately.



We expect you to understand what the numbers mean, not simply copy them into a spreadsheet.



4. Meta Asset Management



A major part of this position is maintaining our Meta infrastructure.



You should be experienced with:



Meta Ads Manager

Meta Business Suite / Business Manager

Ad Accounts

 Pages

Pixels / datasets

Permissions and access

Campaign and account troubleshooting



When something goes wrong, we expect you to investigate the problem first.



Depending on the situation, you will coordinate with us to repair, replace or reorganize affected assets.



5. Organization & Ownership



We operate multiple products, campaigns and Meta assets simultaneously.



You must be able to:



Work independently

Follow daily routines without constant reminders

Keep campaign sheets organized

Identify missing assets or information

Communicate problems early

Coordinate required tasks with other team members

Get approval when required instead of making unauthorized changes



We want someone who takes ownership of the operation while understanding when a decision needs approval.



Required Experience



This is not an entry-level position.



You should already have practical experience managing Meta advertising campaigns.



Experience with dropshipping or high-volume ecommerce advertising is strongly preferred.



You should:



Have hands-on Meta Ads Manager experience

Understand campaign setup and structure

Know how to launch and monitor product tests

Understand scaling and killing decisions

Understand core Meta advertising KPIs

Be comfortable working across multiple Ad Accounts

Understand Meta Business Manager and its assets

Be able to troubleshoot common Meta issues

Be comfortable working with spreadsheets and structured SOPs

Communicate clearly in English

What We're Looking For



The right person is:



Reliable

Analytical

Highly organized

Detail-oriented

Comfortable with repetitive daily routines

Able to follow rules precisely

Able to work independently

Proactive when problems occur

Comfortable taking responsibility for campaigns involving real advertising spend



Small mistakes in campaign setup can cost real money. Accuracy and reliability are therefore as important as media buying knowledge.



Growth Opportunity



This position starts as an operational Media Buyer / Campaign Manager role.



However, we are building our team and advertising infrastructure for the long term.



For someone who consistently demonstrates strong performance, reliability and decision-making, there is an opportunity to grow into a Head of Media Buying / Meta Ads Operations position with significantly more responsibility.



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



How many years of hands-on Meta Ads experience do you have?

Have you worked with dropshipping or performance ecommerce before?

What approximate monthly Meta ad spend have you managed?

Which KPIs do you primarily use when d
 whether to kill or scale a campaign?

Describe your typical daily routine when managing multiple active Meta campaigns.

What would you check if a campaign is scheduled to launch but is not spending?

What experience do you have managing Meta Business Managers, Ad Accounts, Pages and Pixels?

Please provide examples or screenshots of previous Meta Ads results if available.



We are specifically looking for real hands-on experience, not theoretical knowledge of
 advertising.

title: VoIP Technical Support Technician
description:

The work is real troubleshooting: a client calls with dropped audio, a failed registration, or calls routing to the wrong place, and you find the actual cause - in the Asterisk configuration, in the SIP exchange, or in the network underneath it. You will administer PBXs day to day (extensions, voi
, call routing, time conditions), read logs to trace call failures, and work alongside internal technical teams on the harder problems. Just as important, you talk to clients directly. Many of them are not technical, so you need to explain what went wrong and what happens next in language they understand, and keep them updated while the ticket is open. This is a fully remote position for a candidate based in the Philippines, working U.S. business hours.



What you’ll do

Administer Asterisk PBX systems day to day - extensions, voi
, call routing, and time conditions

Troubleshoot SIP issues end to end: registration failures, call routing problems, one-way or missing audio, and call quality

Analyse PBX and SIP logs to trace call failures to their actual cause

Diagnose networking issues affecting voice traffic - IP addressing, DNS, NAT, and general connectivity

Own support tickets from first contact through to resolution, keeping the ticketing system accurate and current

Communicate directly with clients by phone and in writing, including clients with no technical background

Collaborate with internal technical teams on complex or escalated issues

Work independently in a fast-paced MSP environment supporting multiple hosted VoIP clients



What we’re looking for

Hands-on Asterisk PBX experience (mandatory)

Solid working knowledge of VoIP and SIP protocols

PBX administration: extensions, voi
, call routing, and time conditions

SIP troubleshooting across registration, call quality, routing, and audio

Networking fundamentals: IP addressing, DNS, NAT, and connectivity

Strong client-facing communication, both on the phone and in writing

Experience working in a ticketing or support system

Log analysis and call failure troubleshooting

Mid-level to senior: strong independent troubleshooting, able to own problems without being walked through them



Nice to have

FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, or ConnectWise Manage (training available)

Experience supporting hosted VoIP or MSP clients

SIP troubleshooting tools and VoIP monitoring platforms

PSA platform experience

F5 Global Talent is a people-first company that hires experienced professionals and places them in long-term, fully remote roles with leading U.S. companies. title: E-commerce AI Graphic Designer
description:
AI Graphic Designer



Exchange Life · Fully Remote · Full-Time Contractor · ~40 hrs/week $15-  $20 USD/hour + $300–$800/month in performance bonuses.



About Exchange Life



Exchange Life is a fast-growing travel jewelry brand selling collectible travel charms. Our content machine has generated over a quarter billion views across TikTok and Instagram, and we're now scaling our image ad creatives to match.



You'll join a lean, fully remote international team of designers, video editors, and content creators, working closely with our Content Lead and Marketing team. This role exists because our image ad output needs to catch up with our video engine, and you'll help build that side of the creative machine.



That's the opportunity: you're not joining a mature department to take instructions. You're building the static side of a content operation that has already proved it can do a quarter billion views.



Where You'll Be in Six Months



Senior Designer.



That's the next title, and it's within reach inside your first six months if your work earns it. A Senior Designer here owns the visual direction of our image ads: you test your own concepts rather than executing briefs, you expand our prompt library, and you set the standard the rest of the team designs to.



It's d
 by performance, not tenure. Produce winners consistently and you'll get there sooner.



What You'll Earn



Base: $20 USD/hour

Performance bonuses: $300–$800/month, paid per winning ad. When a creative you made hits our performance thresholds or scales on paid, you get paid for it.

There's no cap on how good your month can be



What Success Looks Like



Within 1–2 weeks, a successful hire is producing 10/10-quality AI image ads by following our process, creating work that passes review without rework and matches the Exchange Life look. From there, success means consistent output, images that perform on ads, and proactive suggestions that improve the process itself.



Core Responsibilities



Generate AI product images using our internal prompts, templates, and workflows

Overlay headlines and copy in Photoshop, matching Exchange Life's visual style

Iterate on designs based on feedback from the team and ad performance

Organize and manage creative assets, keeping our AI image library clean and up to date

Communicate proactively about bottlenecks, capacity, and output



Must-Haves



Intermediate Adobe Photoshop skills (this is your main tool)

Solid grasp of text placement and typography for ad creatives

A portfolio showing clean, polished design work

Able to follow a creative brief and established process independently

Reliable communicator who shares their opinion and flags issues early

Clear written and spoken English

Stable internet connection

Nice-to-Haves



AI image generation experience (Higgsfield or similar tools)

Experience in e-commerce, DTC, or social media ad creative



What You'll Learn Here



AI creative is the fastest-moving skill in marketing right now, and most designers are learning it on personal projects with no feedback loop. You'll learn it on real ad spend.



Direct access to ad performance data on your own creatives, so you learn what converts, not just what looks good

Our internal prompt library and workflows, plus the paid AI tools to run them

1-on-1 mentorship from our Content Lead

Paid courses and software

A portfolio of creatives with performance numbers attached, which is the thing that gets designers hired at the next level



Not a Fit If



You need a fixed schedule or close supervision to stay productive

You're looking for a short-term project or side gig

You want to make art rather than ads that perform



Working Style



Engagement: Independent contractor, paid in USD

Location: 100% remote

Hours: ~40 hrs/week, long-term role

Schedule: Fully flexible. Work whenever you want, as long as you deliver and communicate daily (async). No timezone overlap required.

Time off: Flexible PTO. Take the time you need, just coordinate with the team.

Tools you'll use: Photoshop, AI image generation tools (Higgsfield or similar), our internal prompt library

Working style: No micromanagement

description:
We're an Australian AI automation agency. You'll be cold calling Australian business owners to book discovery meetings for us. Straight outbound dialling — no inbound, no chat support, no admin.



**READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING**



This role calls Australian business owners who hang up fast. You need to sound neutral or American on the phone. If your accent is noticeably Filipino, please don't apply.  We will reject you and it wastes both our time. Be honest with yourself here.



**What you'll do**

- 100+ outbound dials per day using our dialler 

- Work Manila 7am-3pm (Melbourne 9am-5pm). Non-negotiable, these are the only hours that work.

- Book qualified meetings into our calendar

- Log every call outcome in our CRM



**What you need**

- 2+ years outbound calling on a US, UK, or Australian account at a real business

- Wired internet connection (not WiFi) and a proper USB headset

- Backup power/internet arrangement

- You can handle rejection all day without going flat by 11am



**HOW TO APPLY - follow this exactly or you'll be rejected**



Do not send a CV or a generic intro video. Send a single audio recording, roughly 90 seconds, with these three parts:



1. **(30 sec)** Read this script word for word:

*"Hi, is that [name]? My name's ___, I was just reaching out because we build AI automation systems for Australian businesses to replace admin tasks. Have you looked at anything like that before?"*



2. **(30 sec)** In your own words, unscripted: why would a business owner want to take this call?

Applications without the audio recording will not be read. Applications that only include part 1 will not be read.

Shortlisted candidates do a live call with us, then a paid trial on real dials before any ongoing arrangement.

title: Rockstar Creator Partnerships Specialist
description:
We are seeking a sharp and persuasive Creator Partnerships Specialist to join our team and build out the influencer arm of our growing supplements brand. Our ideal candidate is a self-starter who can write to strangers and get them to say yes, then keep them warm enough to work with us again.



As our Creator Partnerships Specialist, you will own our entire US creator program end to end. You will find small American creators on Instagram, send them the offer, get product into their hands, and make sure the video actually gets posted. You need to think about why people follow through and why they do not, then change what we are doing based on what the numbers tell you.



We are early on this. We ran a first round, learned a lot from it, and just rebuilt the process from the ground up based on what we found. There is a system in place now, along with a tracker and message templates, so you are not starting from nothing. But it is new enough that parts of it will be wrong, and you 

are the person who gets to find out which parts.



This is NOT for you if:



- You can't commit at least 4 hours a day to outreach, follow-up, and tracking

- You want a job where someone hands you a script and you just run it

- You are only comfortable writing formal business English and cannot switch to the casual way Americans actually text

- You get uncomfortable following up with people or you drop off after one unanswered message

- You are not willing to look at your own numbers every week and admit when something is not working

- You want a role where nobody ever questions your output, or where you never question anyone else's



While we deeply respect the hustle and entrepreneurial drive, for this role we are seeking an intrapreneur. Someone who will bring that same initiative and problem-solving, but point all of it at one thing, which is getting more creators to say yes and follow through. You are not starting from a blank page, and you are also not just following what is there. If you look at how we do something and think it is wrong, we want to hear that in week one, not month six.



At EdenBoost, you will get the real numbers, the real budget, and direct access to the person who runs growth here. No layers, no ticket queue. You will also learn things that outlast this job, including how to tell where a buyer is in their thinking and write to that exact stage, how sales copy is actually built, and what the performance data behind our ad campaigns really says. Almost nobody at this level gets to look at that.



You will work Philippine daytime hours, roughly 7am to 12nn Manila time. No night shift, no graveyard. That is not us being generous, it just works out. Morning here is evening in the US, which is exactly when American creators are on their phones.



SKILLS REQUIRED



Our ideal candidate combines persuasive writing with clear thinking about numbers, and has the patience to follow up with people without becoming a nuisance.



Must have:



Excellent written English, with the ability to write casually and naturally to an American audience. Short, warm, direct, plenty of contractions, no Ma'am or Sir, no long formal opening



Experience getting strangers to respond. Cold messaging, sales, community management, customer service, recruitment, or running your own social account all count



Comfortable working in spreadsheets and keeping a tracker accurate without being reminded



Competent with AI tools for research, sorting, and drafting, and able to explain how you use them and where you stop trusting them



Able to read a simple funnel and reason about where people are dropping off



Willing to question a process you were handed instead of quietly following it



Based in the Philippines and able to work Philippine daytime hours



Nice to have:



Influencer marketing, creator outreach, or UGC coordination experience



Familiarity with Meta Business Suite and Meta's Creator Marketplace



You watch a lot of American creator content and have opinions about why some of it works



You have built yourself a small system in Sheets, Notion, or Airtable because you got tired of doing something by hand



Previous work with US clients or a US audience



THE TEST



We do not want a resume. We want to see how you write to real people, so here are two short tasks.



Both should take you under ten minutes. Keep your whole answer under 250 words.



Task 1. Write a first message to a creator.



Find a real US creator on Instagram or TikTok with under 10,000 followers who you would pitch for a supplements brand.



Give us their handle and one sentence on why you picked them.



Then write the exact message you would send them, offering a free product in exchange for one short video. Write the real message, word for word, the way you would actually send it. Do not describe it. Do not explain it. Just write it.



Task 2. Write a follow-up to a creator who went quiet.



Here is the situation.



A creator agreed to the deal. We shipped the product. It was delivered eleven days ago. She has not posted, and she has not replied to your last two messages.



Write the message you would send her now.



Then add one sentence telling us why you wrote it that way.



One more thing. Start your application with the word SEEDING so we know you read this far.



We read every application, and we reply to everyone who applies properly, yes or no.

title: Cabinet Engineer/Shop Drawing Specialist
description:
Cabinet Engineer / Shop Drawing Specialist — Remote (Philippines)



Company: Selhorst Woodworks — Custom Millwork & Finish Carpentry (Las Vegas, NV, USA) Type: Full-time, remote, long-term Pay: $275 USD per week Start date: Immediately



About Us



We are a custom millwork and finish carpentry shop in Las Vegas, Nevada. We specialize in custom wall units, mud rooms, entertainment built-ins, and other architectural millwork. Everything we make is custom — no catalog boxes, no repeat SKUs. Our shop drawings have to be right the first time, because a mistake on paper becomes an expensive mistake in wood.



We are looking for one experienced cabinet engineer to join our team long-term.



The Role



You will take approved designs and field measurements and turn them into complete, buildable shop drawings that our shop can cut and assemble without asking questions.



Day to day, you will:



Model complete cabinet runs and individual casework in Fusion 360

Produce shop drawings: plans, elevations, sections, and detail views with full dimensions

Generate cut lists and panel/part breakdowns for the shop

Specify joinery, construction methods, panel materials, edgebanding, and hardware

Lay out doors, drawer fronts, and reveals; call out overlays, gaps, and finished ends

Detail hardware placement — hinges, slides, lift systems, pulls, adjustable shelving

Coordinate with our designers and project managers on revisions and field changes

Flag design problems before they hit the shop floor — bad clearances, out-of-square wall conditions, impossible reveals

What You Must Have

Real cabinet and custom cabinet experience. You have engineered custom casework before, not just furniture or general product design.

Fusion 360 proficiency you already have. You can model, assemble, and produce dimensioned drawings today, with no training period.

You understand frameless cabinet construction. We build euro frameless only — no face frame. 32mm system, full overlay, box construction, joinery methods, sheet goods, edgebanding, hardware sizing, and how tolerances stack up.

You can read and work from architectural drawings and field measurements.

File-exchange fluency. You can reliably import and export between Fusion 360 and AutoCAD and SketchUp — DWG, DXF, STEP — and keep dimensions, layers, and scale intact through the round trip. Our upstream drawings come to you in AutoCAD and SketchUp, and this cannot be a weak spot.

Strong written English. Almost all of our coordination happens in writing.

Reliable internet, a computer that runs Fusion 360 comfortably, and a quiet place to work.

Availability to overlap with Las Vegas business hours (Pacific Time) for part of your day.

Strongly Preferred

Hands-on shop experience actually building cabinets. If you have run a saw, assembled boxes, or installed casework, we want to talk to you first.

Experience preparing files for CNC — nesting, part labeling, machining callouts

Experience working with a US-based shop or US construction standards

Comfort working in imperial units (inches and fractions) — this is how all of our drawings are dimensioned

Who This Is Not For

Anyone who needs to learn Fusion 360 on the job

General 3D modelers or renderers with no cabinet background

Anyone who cannot commit to a consistent full-time weekly schedule

Compensation and Terms

$275 USD per week, paid weekly

Full-time, long-term position with room to grow as our volume grows

Paid time off after an initial trial period

Work is 100% remote

How to Apply



Send an application that includes all of the following. Applications missing any item will not be reviewed.



A short introduction — where you have worked, and what kind of cabinets you engineered there.

Portfolio or work samples of cabinet shop drawings you personally produced. PDFs are fine. If your past work is confidential, send anything you own or have created on your own.

Confirmation of your years of Fusion 360 experience and what you use it for.

Whether you have hands-on shop or installation experience, and where.

A description of how you move files between Fusion 360 and AutoCAD or SketchUp — which formats you use and what you watch out for.

Your computer specs and internet speed.

Your available working hours in Pacific Time.

Start the first line of your message with the word DOVETAIL so we know you read this posting completely.



Qualified applicants will be given a short paid test project — one real cabinet drawn to our standard — before hire.
