title: US Quickbooks Bookkeeper
description:
THE IDEAL CANDIDATE:

-Has experience working in an online consulting company or social media business in the online entrepreneurial space.

-Has an understanding of, or willingness to learn TikTok Shop affiliate or creator-based income streams and how they impact basic bookkeeping and revenue tracking.

-Is a quick start who quickly turns tasks around and takes action; knows how to be persistent and resourceful to solve -problems, remove roadblocks and get things done.

-Has strong EQ and can intuit next steps without needing a ton of direction- we like to call this “thinking ahead of the CEO.”

-Doesn’t take corrections personally and can handle a fast moving, sometimes high pressure business in social media.

-Is the type of person who makes a mistake once and instead of wasting energy beating yourself up and feeling bad channels that energy into implementing systems so that the same mistake is never repeated.

-Has a love for creating SOPs and regularly maintains and updates them for their job responsibilities without needing to be reminded to do so.

-Exhibits strong professionalism - demonstrated poise, tact, and diplomacy when dealing with the CEO, other leaders and members of the team. Can take feedback without taking it personally

-Must be able to work independently and excel in a deadline-driven environment that involves multiple, simultaneous projects and sometimes quick turnarounds.

-Strong skills in analyzing information, formulating logical and objective conclusions and making effective recommendations.

-Superior organization skills and dedication to completing projects in a timely manner.

-Has a genuine passion for supporting others and is a team player.

-Enjoys sharing ideas to improve processes within the company when they see gaps that can be improved.

-Has a high attention to detail- grammatical errors and typos never get past you.

-Enjoys taking ownership of their role and treats the company’s front-facing assets and appearance with the same level of excellence as if it was their own.



JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

-Assists Senior Admin team with onboarding new clients/brands through setting up payment pages for custom programs, managing the cancellation and off-boarding process, troubleshooting technical issues with the senior admin team, creating contracts in DocuSign and sending them out.

-From time to time support other admins in maintenance of the CEO's calendar or inboxes in a thoughtful and purposeful manner, guarding the CEO’s time by ensuring meetings contain the appropriate attendees, agenda items, links to Zoom, address details and any changes are done with full consideration of a nationwide/worldwide team, spanning multiple time zones.

-Drafting internal and external communications as needed and instructed by the senior admin team.

-Provide support with financial tasks and reporting

-Issue invoices to brands and clients upon completion of agreed deliverables, making sure all invoice requirements follow what is in the contract.

-Maintain accurate records of all invoices, payments received, outstanding balances, and client payment histories.

-Performs credit control activities like proactively following up on overdue invoices and maintaining regular communication with brands regarding outstanding payments.

-Monitor accounts receivable and provide regular reports on unpaid invoices

-Monitor credit and government loan accounts for the business to ensure no delinquency or late fees

-Prepare quarterly budgets and assist with financial planning for the CEO

-Track monthly revenue, lost revenue, and payment trends

-Reconcile bank accounts and PayPal

-Record and categorize all business income and expenses in the accounting system.

-Process reimbursements and maintain supporting documentation for all business expenses.



Experience and Skills Required:

-3+ years of bookkeeping experience

-Advanced proficiency in QuickBooks; QB certification a huge plus

-4-year degree in Accounting or a similar field

-Demonstrate a solid typing WPM (ideally 45 wpm)

-Excellent English skills, and able to communicate well both verbally and in writing

-Experience with remote team tools like Slack, Asana, Google Suite, LastPass, CocoSign (document signing), VideoAsk, Loom and Zoom



Tech Requirements:

-Computer - at least i5 or equivalent with 8gb RAM

-Internet Speed - At least 50 MBPS Download speed





We are an asynchronous team, which means we work across various time zones. CEO is in the United States and typically works Monday-Friday, 10am-2pm Eastern Time



This is for a part-time position of about 20 hours per week with room to grow!



Salary Range: (20 hours) Php 24,000 to Php 42,000





Apply here: 
/appqNAvkEQ10YFlc3/pag1aWSMwCfLhrMXv/form

title: Director of Recruiting — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based direct-hire staffing firm (healthcare/allied-health core, expanding into new verticals) is hiring a Director of Recruiting to own our ENTIRE delivery organization. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder — every recruiting lane, every recruiter, and the company-wide fill number are yours.



This is a staffing-agency delivery leadership seat, not a corporate HR/TA role. You inherit a live board of open US jobs and a small existing delivery team (including a recruiting manager), and you are accountable for one thing: jobs filled. You set the per-req fill strategy across the whole board, install the standards and cadence, coach and grow the team — and because we're a lean firm, you still personally recruit on the hardest, highest-value searches.



Responsibilities

- Own the company-wide open-req board: triage every US job, set a written fill strategy per req, kill or escalate stalled searches honestly.

- Lead the whole delivery org — the recruiting manager and delivery recruiters report to you; run the daily cadence, set quality-gated submittal standards per recruiter, and manage performance to them.

- Personally recruit full-cycle on priority searches: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit.

- Build the machine: playbooks, screening gates, KPIs, capacity plan; recruit and onboard recruiters as volume grows.

- Report the truth to the founder weekly with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



Required

- 6+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, with 3+ years leading delivery teams measured on submittals and placements — agency/staffing-firm side (BPO/RPO delivery centers serving US staffing firms count; in-house corporate TA does not). Leading team leads or managers is a strong plus.

- US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

- Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements (role, US state, salary) and walk through exactly how you filled them. There WILL be a detailed walkthrough on the interview.

- Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

- Excellent spoken English — you screen US healthcare professionals and coach everyone who does; live spoken check included.

- Fluent with ATS platforms, modern sourcing, and delivery metrics; can build a KPI dashboard, not just read one.

**Do NOT apply if:** your leadership is in-house corporate TA/HR (not agency delivery); you've led sourcing/CV-mining teams only and never owned submittals-to-fill; you cannot name specific placements you personally closed; you're a pure people-manager who no longer recruits; your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US clinicians; or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: the whole delivery organization is yours — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy, standards, and team build-out, competitive director-level base plus a placement-linked bonus tied to the fills your org produces, fully remote, long-term.



## APPLICATION QUESTIONS

1. The largest delivery organization you've led: company, your title, total headcount (and layers — did team leads/managers report to you?), what the org was measured on, and its typical monthly submittals + placements.

2. Name ONE placement you PERSONALLY closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. *(Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)*

3. Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

4. You inherit this board: ~20 open US direct-hire jobs (mostly healthcare/allied), a recruiting manager, and 2 recruiters; fill rate has been ~20%. In 5–8 sentences: your first 30 days, step by step, and the number you'd promise the founder for day 90.

5. Can you commit to a FIXED US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet?

6. Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), earliest start date, and a **30–60 sec voice intro** (link) introducing yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

### IMPORTANT APPLICATION INSTRUCTION

Example format only:



PURPLE BANANA | Your City | Your Favorite Food | Your Editing Software

title: Software Engineer + Digital Marketing (GTM, Google Ads, Landing Pages)
description:
We are Pilot Practice (KloudMD) — a US company that builds software and marketing systems for medical practices.



This is a SOFTWARE ENGINEER seat with marketing work attached. It is NOT a virtual assistant job and NOT a social-media-poster job. If you spend your day making Canva carousels and calling that "digital marketing," do not apply.



WHO WE NEED

A software engineer (PHP, JavaScript, HTML/CSS — WordPress or Laravel is ideal) who also understands digital marketing well enough to own the implementation: Google Tag Manager, Google Ads / Meta conversion tracking, landing pages, forms, UTMs, pixels, call tracking (DNI), GA4.



You do not need to be a media buyer. You DO need to read a network request, fix a dataLayer push, notice a clinic booker showing 2am slots, and say what you would do in the next 20 minutes.



You will work with our US marketing team (ads + social already exist). You are the technical executor.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

- Build and QA landing pages (WordPress / HTML / light JS). Headlines, forms, mobile, thank-you pages.

- Own conversion tracking: GTM, GA4, Meta Pixel, Google Ads conversions (including offline / booked-appointment conversions — a form submit is not a booked consult).

- Diagnose broken funnels. Ad click ? landing page or booking widget ? CRM ? (sometimes) EHR. Find which hop died.

- Call tracking / number swap (DNI). Ads have a tracking number. The website footer often still shows the main office line.

- UTM + source slugs. So we can see which ad, keyword, and page made the lead.

- Light ad-account work: read Google Ads or Meta, spot wasted spend, write a one-page diagnosis.

- Implement, not just recommend. If you say "add a listener on form submit," you can do it in GTM or in the page in front of me.



MUST HAVE

- You write production HTML/CSS/JS (and preferably PHP). This is an engineering job.

- You have published a GTM container, not only watched a YouTube video.

- You can explain pageview vs form submit vs "consult requested" vs "appointment actually booked" without mixing them up.

- You can look at a landing page or booker and say why it will not convert — including healthcare landmines (fake urgency, guaranteed outcomes, missing DOB, slots at 2am).

- English a US doctor's office would trust. Video interview.

- Night-shift overlap with Arizona, USA (MST). At least 4 hours overlap with 8am–5pm Arizona. 40 hrs/week.



NICE TO HAVE

- Laravel / PHP APIs, WordPress / Elementor, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, Looker Studio.

- Google Ads or Meta you personally ran, with numbers (spend, CPA, what you changed).

- Healthcare, clinics, or any regulated lead gen.



PAY

$8–$12 USD/hour based on the live working test, not your resume. 40 hours/week. Paid 4-hour trial before any long-term offer. Higher if you can clearly engineer, not just click around Ads.



KEYWORDS (so the right people find this)

Software engineer, web developer, PHP, JavaScript, WordPress, Laravel, digital marketing, Google Tag Manager, GTM, Google Ads, PPC, Meta Ads,
 Ads, GA4, Google Analytics, conversion tracking, landing pages, pixels, UTM, call tracking, DNI.



HOW WE THINK — A REAL CLIENT EXAMPLE (READ THIS)

This is a real i
 we had. We are giving you the answer so you see the bar. Do not copy this structure blindly into your application.



What the client said: "People on our booking page are seeing 2:00am and 3:00am appointment times. We are a Chicago clinic. We are open 8am–5pm."



What a ChatGPT answer looks like: "Please verify timezone settings are consistent across your systems and consider using a timezone library."



What actually happened: the clinic's location timezone was Chicago. The booking-channel hours were 8–5. A hidden availability row still defaulted to UTC. The booker used that row. 8am Chicago became 2–3am on the public widget. Ads were sending paid traffic to a page that looked broken. "Fix the ads" would have done nothing.



What we needed someone to do in the first 20 minutes, talking the whole time:

1. Open the live booker as a visitor (not logged into WordPress). Pick tomorrow. Write down the first three slot times.

2. Ask: what city is this clinic in, and what hours do they tell patients?

3. If slots are outside 6am–10pm in that city, stop talking about pixels. The conversion problem is the product, not GTM.

4. Compare one slot to what the clinic's calendar / EHR shows for the same day.

5. Only after the slots look human, check whether ads conversions match CRM bookings.



If you cannot follow that kind of thinking, you will hate this job.



YOUR APPLICATION — A DIFFERENT REAL CASE. DO NOT PASTE THIS INTO CHATGPT AND REWRITE IT.



Most applications we get are written by ChatGPT. We will not interview those.



1) First line of your application must be exactly: WIRE-MANGO-18

2) Do not start with "I am writing to express my interest" or "I am a results-driven professional."

3) Answer THIS case in 8–12 sentences, no bullet lists. Use your own words. Name the exact screens you would open, in order. If you have seen this in real life, say what the actual cause was last time.



THE CASE:

A Phoenix-area medical practice. We spent $1,800 on Google Search ads last week. Google Ads shows 41 conversions. Our CRM (Pilot Practice) shows 6 new contacts whose source looks like Google. Only 2 of those 6 have an appointment on the calendar. The doctor says "the phones rang all day, ads must be working, why is your report so low?" The website footer and the booking widget both show the main office number, (480)
. In Google Ads, the call-extension number is a different number we provisioned for tracking. The booking widget is an embed on a WordPress page. Some thank-you / "consult requested" tags fire when someone only opens the booker, not when they finish. The practice's EHR will reject a new-patient booking that has no date of birth.



What are the 2–4 most likely explanations, ranked? What would you check first, and what would you refuse to "fix" in Ads until you had looked at the live page? Do not give a generic "audit the pixel" essay.



4) Paste a 60–90 second video (Loom / Drive / unlisted YouTube). Camera on. Handwritten paper with today's date and WIRE-MANGO-18. Then talk — do not read — about the last tracking, call-tracking, or landing-page problem you personally fixed. For 10 seconds, show the actual tool (GTM, Chrome DevTools, WordPress, or Ads).



If you cannot do the video, do not apply. If you use AI to write #3, we will know on the live call and we will end it.



We hire the person who can do the work on a shared screen, not the person with the prettiest cover letter.

description:

What you'll draw

Millwork — vanities, built-ins, closets, kitchens, paneling. Elevations, sections, details, with real reveals, clearances, and material callouts. This is the heart of the job.

Full CAD sets — floor plans, RCPs, lighting layouts, elevations, sections, dimension and finish plans

Schedules — door, window, plumbing, lighting, finish. Tagged and kept in sync as things change.

Presentation PDFs and redline turnaround

What I'm looking for

Degree in architecture, 3+ years drafting interiors, residential, or millwork

Strong AutoCAD — xrefs, layer standards, blocks, paper space, plot styles

Imperial units and US drafting conventions

Detail-oriented enough to catch the door tagged twice or the schedule that no longer matches the plan

Good English, written and spoken

Your own home wifi, a backup for brownouts, and a computer that runs AutoCAD without lagging

Standard US kitchen counter height in inches?

Rendering experience? Which software?

title: Technical Draftsperson
description:
Full-Time Remote | New Zealand Business Hours | ?70,000–?100,000 per month, depending on experience and capability. 



About Us

We are a New Zealand-based company specialising in the design, engineering and manufacture of ventilation, acoustic and screening systems for construction projects.

We’re looking for a capable Technical Draftsperson to join our team and support the production of technical, shop and construction drawings.



About the Role

You will work closely with our sales, design and operations teams to produce accurate drawings and technical documentation using SketchUp, LayOut and AutoCAD.

This role requires more than simply following instructions. We need someone who can think through problems, understand what they are drawing, identify issues and ask good questions when something doesn’t make sense.



Key Responsibilities

* Produce pre-sales, shop, construction and fabrication drawings

* Create and update SketchUp models and LayOut drawing sets

* Produce and revise AutoCAD drawings

* Prepare clear construction and installation details

* Interpret architectural drawings and technical information

* Review and revise drawings based on feedback

* Identify missing information or potential technical issues

* Work closely with our sales, design and operations teamsRequirements

* Strong proficiency in SketchUp and LayOut

* Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, particularly 2D technical drawings

* Experience with shop, construction or fabrication drawings

* Good understanding of construction and architectural detailing

* Very fluent spoken and written English

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy

* Good general IT and software skills

* Reliable home office, internet and power setup

* Willingness to work New Zealand business hours



Clear English communication is essential. You will regularly receive and discuss technical instructions with our New Zealand team, so we need to be able to understand each other easily and accurately.

Most Importantly — You Need to Think

We are looking for someone who can think independently and solve problems, not simply say “yes” to an instruction and turn to ChatGPT for the answer.



We value people who:

* Think before acting

* Ask intelligent questions

* Notice when something doesn't look right

* Check their own work

* Use common sense and technical judgement

* Take ownership of finding solutions



AI tools are useful, but they should support your thinking not replace it.



Preferred Experience

Experience in any of the following would be advantageous:

* Façades, cladding, glazing or architectural metalwork

* Manufacturing or fabrication drawings

* Ventilation or construction systems

* Bluebeam or Adobe Acrobat

title: Content Editor & Virtual Assistant
description:
Video Editor & Virtual Assistant

Personal Brand | UGC | Frame Your Voice (company I am building)

I’m looking for a highly organised, proactive Video Editor & Virtual Assistant to work closely with me across my personal brand, UGC campaigns and growing online businesses.

This is not simply a VA position.

The #1 priority is video editing.

I need someone who understands modern short-form content, attention, pacing, storytelling and retention — and who can learn my editing style well enough that I can send over raw footage with clear direction and trust that the finished product will come back ready to post.

Alongside editing, I need someone who can gradually take ownership of the organisation and repetitive day-to-day tasks behind the brand, freeing me up to focus on creating, selling, coaching and growing the businesses.

???? PRIMARY ROLE — VIDEO EDITING

You’ll edit content across several different styles and purposes.

Personal Brand Content

My main page has its own editing methodology and visual identity. You’ll need to learn how I structure content, including:

Fast-paced short-form Reels

Talking-head educational and mindset content

Storytelling content

B-roll and voiceover edits

Green-screen content

Viral/trending formats and trial Reels

Strong on-screen hooks and text placement

Captions/subtitles

Music selection and timing

Strategic cuts, zooms and pattern interrupts

Images, screenshots and supporting visuals

Colour grading and visual consistency

Retention-focused pacing while keeping the content authentic

The goal isn't to over-edit everything. It's to understand when a video needs energy and movement and when the story is strong enough to let the content breathe.

UGC & Brand Campaigns

UGC requires a slightly different editing style from my personal brand.

I’ll provide raw footage, scripts, brand requirements and creative direction. You’ll be responsible for turning those assets into polished deliverables, including:

Cutting and structuring raw footage

Colour grading

Captions and text overlays

Green-screen images/video

B-roll and supporting assets

Music and sound

Multiple hooks or variations when required

Following campaign briefs

Creating clean, professional exports ready for delivery to brands

You’ll need to understand the difference between content designed for my audience and content created for a brand to use as an advertisement or UGC asset.

???? CONTENT MANAGEMENT & GROWTH

As you learn the brand, I’d like you to gradually help manage the operational side of my social platforms.

This will include:

Creating and posting 5–10 trial Reels per day when required

Preparing posts for publishing

Maintaining consistent content output

Monitoring comments and engagement

Responding to appropriate comments and interactions

Helping keep engagement high across pages

Daily intentional outreach to relevant people/accounts

Helping identify conversations, leads or opportunities that require my personal response

Supporting the growth of my main personal brand as Frame Your Voice develops

I don't want robotic engagement or generic copy-and-paste comments. Everything attached to my name needs to feel human.

????? VIRTUAL ASSISTANT & ORGANISATION

The second part of the role is helping bring structure to an increasingly busy schedule.

My days can run from approximately 4:00 a.m. training through to 8:30 p.m., with content creation, client work, UGC, meetings, business development, family time and training all needing to fit together.

I need someone who can help me create and maintain a clear Daily Operating Procedure rather than simply reacting to whatever comes up.

Over time, responsibilities may include:

Calendar organisation and management

Weekly planning

Daily schedule preparation

Time blocking

Content calendars

Filming and editing schedules

Tracking UGC deliverables and deadlines

Frame Your Voice tasks and client commitments

Reminders and follow-ups

Maintaining task lists and priorities

Organising raw footage, finished edits and digital assets

Identifying scheduling conflicts before they become problems

Helping create systems and SOPs as the businesses grow

I don't just need someone who waits for a list of instructions.

I want someone who notices what needs doing and helps create the system around it.

???? WHO I’M LOOKING FOR

The right person is:

A genuinely skilled short-form editor first, and a highly organised operator second.

You should be comfortable with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or equivalent, and understand modern vertical content for Instagram and TikTok.

More importantly, you should understand why an edit works — hooks, pacing, retention, emotion, storytelling and attention — rather than simply knowing how to use editing software.

You’ll ideally be:

Creative and detail-oriented

Extremely organised

Reliable with deadlines

Comfortable receiving direct feedback

Able to learn a specific editing methodology

Proactive rather than constantly waiting for instructions

Familiar with Instagram, TikTok and short-form content

Comfortable working quickly without sacrificing quality

Interested in social media, personal branding and online business

Able to communicate clearly

Willing to learn and grow alongside the businesses

???? WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Initially, success is simple:

I create ? you help turn it into exceptional content ? we distribute it consistently.

As we build systems together, I want the relationship to evolve towards:

I create. I coach. I sell. I build.

While you increasingly help manage:

Editing. Content operations. Organisation. Scheduling. Distribution.

Ultimately, I’m looking for someone who can become a trusted right hand across the creative and operational side of what I’m building.

There is significant room for the role to grow as the brands and businesses grow.

If you’re an exceptional editor who also loves organisation, systems and making things happen — I’d love to hear from you.



Main personal brand on

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter — US Storm Damage Roofing (Base + Bonus + Commission)
description:
Read this whole post. There are specific application instructions at the bottom, and I delete anything that doesn't follow them.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're a US-based agency that works with roofing contractors. When a hailstorm hits a neighborhood, we call the homeowners in that area, let them know their roof may have storm damage that their insurance covers, and offer them a free inspection from our contractor.



You are the person making those calls.



This is not a read-the-script-and-hang-up job. You're the first human voice these homeowners hear about something that could save them thousands of dollars. Your job is to get them interested, qualify them properly, book them onto the contractor's calendar, and make sure they actually show up.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Call homeowners in recently storm-affected US zip codes from lists we provide (you are not finding your own leads)

- Explain that their area was hit and that storm damage is often covered by their homeowner's insurance

- Qualify them: age of roof, do they own the home, do they currently carry homeowner's insurance, has another contractor or adjuster already inspected the roof, plus a few more we'll train you on

- Book qualified homeowners directly onto our contractor's calendar

- Follow up by call and text before the appointment so the homeowner actually shows

- Log every call outcome in the CRM (GoHighLevel — we'll train you)

- Report your numbers daily: dials, contacts, qualified, booked



WHO THIS IS FOR



- You've done outbound cold calling to US consumers before and it doesn't scare you

- Clear, easy-to-understand English on the phone. Homeowners are often older. If they have to say "sorry, what?" twice, the call is lost.

- You can take fifty no's in a row and dial number fifty-one with the same energy

- You listen more than you talk, and you can think on your feet when someone goes off-script

- You're organized enough to keep a calendar clean and follow up without being reminded



WHO THIS IS NOT FOR



- Anyone whose experience is inbound support,
, or general admin VA work

- Anyone who needs to be micromanaged

- Anyone who can't commit to US hours

- Anyone sending the same copy-paste message to fifty job posts today



HOURS



Important: our calling zones change depending on where storms hit, so hours shift with the campaign — sometimes US Eastern, sometimes Central, sometimes Pacific. In practice, you're working nights Philippine time, generally between 9PM and 9AM PHT, around 40 hours a week. If you can't reliably commit to a night shift that occasionally moves by a few hours, this role won't work for you.



TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS



- 20 Mbps minimum, stable, wired connection preferred

- Backup internet (pocket wifi or mobile data) and backup power. Dropped calls mid-pitch cost us money.

- A quiet, dedicated workspace with no background noise on calls

- Noise-cancelling USB headset

- A computer that runs a browser-based dialer and CRM without lag



WHAT WE PROVIDE



- Fresh, storm-verified lead lists

- Dialer and CRM

- Scripts, rebuttals, and the qualifying framework

- Training and call reviews. We will coach you, and we expect you to be coachable.



HOW TO APPLY



Follow these exactly.



1. Start your message with the word HAILSTORM. If it's not the first word, I won't read the rest.



2. In 3-4 sentences, tell me about the outbound campaign you're proudest of. What were you selling, who were you calling, what were your numbers?



3. Record a voice sample about 60 seconds long (Google Drive link, Loom, or any audio file). Introduce yourself, then pretend I'm a homeowner in Dallas whose neighborhood just got hit by hail, and pitch me on a free roof inspection. Improvise it. I'm judging clarity, warmth, and whether you sound like a real person instead of a robot.



4. Tell me your internet speed and whether you have backup power.



5. Tell me the earliest date you can start.



Applications without a voice sample get deleted unread.



I'm hiring one person and I'm willing to wait for the right one. If that's you, show me.

PAY

[INSERT PAY RANGE — e.g. $4-8/hr or $700-1,300/mo depending on experience]



ABOUT THE ROLE

Baja AI Automation builds and manages all-in-one GoHighLevel systems (CRM, missed-call text-back, Conversation AI bots, local SEO, websites) for local service businesses — plumbing, window cleaning, junk removal, and similar trades. We need a detail-oriented GHL admin who can take a new client from signed contract to a fully live system, then keep every existing sub-account running clean.



This is a hands-on-the-platform role, not a sales or client-facing role. You'll be inside GHL every day building, cloning, configuring, and troubleshooting.



RESPONSIBILITIES

- GOOGLE SEO, AUTOMATIONS, WORKFLOWS

- Build new client sub-accounts from our master snapshot and customize them per business (business name, logo, colors, service area, offer details)

- Set up and configure Conversation AI bots per client using our instructions/knowledge-base format — tone, qualifying questions, custom fields to capture, booking links, special-situation rules (spam, angry customer, out of area, etc.)

- Create and map Custom Fields and Custom Values for each sub-account so bots, forms, and workflows pull the right data

- Configure missed-call text-back, calendars, and appointment booking flows

- Build and edit funnel/website pages inside GHL (cloning and adapting existing templates, not custom dev)

- Set up workflows/automations (lead routing, follow-up sequences, appointment reminders)

- Handle A2P 10DLC registration and phone number setup for new sub-accounts

- QA every new client build against a checklist before it goes live — catch broken links, wrong merge fields, untested bot flows

- Monitor existing client accounts for issues (bot misfires, broken automations, missed messages) and fix them proactively

- Keep our internal SOP docs and snapshot templates up to date as we refine the process

- Communicate clearly in written English about what's done, what's blocked, and what needs a decision from us



REQUIREMENTS

- Solid hands-on experience with GoHighLevel specifically (sub-accounts, snapshots, workflows, Conversation AI/bots, Custom Fields vs Custom Values, calendars, funnels) — not just "CRM experience" in general

- Comfortable following a written SOP/checklist precisely, and comfortable flagging when something in the SOP doesn't fit a specific client

- Strong written English for both internal communication and reviewing client-facing bot copy

title: Wedding Video Editor
description:
Haze Photo and Film is a wedding photography and videography studio based in Australia looking for a freelance video editor for ongoing, per-project work. We handle all filming. You'll receive raw footage and edit it into finished wedding films.



**How it works:**



We send you the raw footage and audio from each wedding. Before editing, we'll debrief the day with you by call or
 and give you direction on story, tone, standout moments to build the edit around and priorities from the couple. 



**Responsibilities:**



- Review raw footage and audio from each wedding alongside our debrief notes, then build an edit that reflects the direction we've given on story, tone, and key moments.

- Sync multicam footage from ceremonies, receptions, and speeches, along with separate audio from lav and room mics to create Documentary films and Ceremony/Speeches Films

- Colour grade and colour correct footage shot across varying light, from outdoor ceremonies to dim reception venues, so the whole film feels visually consistent.

- Choose music that matches the couple's taste and the emotional beats of the day, from quiet vow moments to high energy reception cuts.

- Structure the edit for pacing, deciding what stays, what gets trimmed, and how scenes flow into each other to tell a cohesive story.

- Cut multiple deliverables from the same footage, including a highlight film, a longer documentary style edit, and short vertical cuts for social media.

- Organise and manage large volumes of raw footage without losing or mixing up files between projects. Take feedback from us and the couple and turn revision notes into a refined final cut within the agreed timeline.



**Requirements:**



At least 1 year prior experience editing wedding films, with a portfolio to show. Fluent in written and spoken English. Fluent in DaVinci Resolve. Strong musicality and a natural sense of storytelling, this role leans heavily on music selection and pacing. Experience with multicam and audio syncing. Comfortable transferring and managing large video files (Dropbox, Google Drive, LucidLink, or similar). Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines.



**Details:**



Freelance, ongoing per-project work. Rate to be discussed based on experience and turnaround.

title: Sales Operations Admin Assistant
description:
We're a fast-growing sales organization looking for a Sales Operations Admin Assistant to support a global closer/setter team. You'll be the operational backbone keeping our pipeline clean, our calendars running, and our prospect calls happening on time.



This is a high-volume, high-responsibility role — expect 50-60 hours/week. We move fast and the pipeline doesn't stop, so we need someone who thrives with a full plate and wants to grow with a serious sales operation, not someone looking for light part-time work. In exchange, you'll get consistent full-time income, a real seat inside a functioning sales team, and room to take on more as you prove yourself.



SHIFT: Start time 6:00 AM EST. This is a hard requirement — the morning workflow below has to be complete before our first sales calls begin at 8-9 AM EST.



DAILY WORKFLOW:

1. No-show/cancellation report — review every no-show and cancellation from the prior day (conversation history + call transcript), write a short summary of what happened and why, note whether a reschedule/objection-overcome attempt was made

2. Inbox check — review responses needed and status changes on leads; pass messages into the appropriate team channel (you will not be responding to prospects directly until fully trained)

3. Calendar grading — build a chronological list of every closer's calls for the day with timestamps, mark each confirmed/unconfirmed, score lead quality 1-10, flag calendar conflicts (double bookings, overlapping calls, personal blocks with a call on top)

4. Appointment switching — move the highest-quality leads onto the best-fit closers' calendars

5. Daily report — send a report to the team channel per closer: lead, time, status, quality score, notes

6. Same-day confirmations — begin no later than 9 AM EST, ideally 8 AM EST



ONGOING (after morning block):

- Work no-shows and reschedules by calling, oldest first: yesterday, 2 days ago, 3 days ago, up to 6 days ago, plus long-term hot follow-ups



REACTIVE (can interrupt the above at any time):

- Speed to lead — if a new lead hasn't been called within 5 minutes, check the inbox and pass along immediately

- Handle cancels/reschedules as they happen — get the lead back on the calendar or at minimum set up the objection to be addressed, then pass to the right closer/setter

- Ongoing inbox monitoring — pass messages into the right channel as they come in, tagged to the right person



REQUIREMENTS:

- 1-2 years of experience in a sales operations, admin, or virtual assistant role

- Excellent organizational skills — you'll be managing multiple moving pieces simultaneously without dropping the ball

- Clear, fluent spoken English with neutral pronunciation — you'll be on the phone with US prospects daily, so easy comprehension for a US caller is essential

- Strong written English as well

- Experience with CRM platforms

- Reliable internet, quiet work environment, backup power/internet a plus

- Must be online by 6:00 AM EST daily, full-time 50-60 hrs/week



NICE TO HAVE:

- Prior sales experience (not required, but a plus — especially outbound calling or appointment setting)

- Experience supporting a sales team specifically (not just general admin)

- Familiarity with outbound/inbound call handling



HOW TO APPLY:

Submit your resume along with:

1. A short video (2 min) introducing yourself and your relevant experience

2. Your available start date

3. Your expected monthly salary (USD)



We respond only to applicants who follow these instructions exactly — this is how we screen for attention to detail.

- The Toddler Code™

This is not a basic administrative role. I need someone who can bring order to moving pieces, turn ideas into action, help keep marketing moving, and use modern AI tools intelligently—not just enthusiastically.



You’ll be supporting several distinct brands, so good judgment matters. I’m not looking for one beige template applied to everything.



What you’ll help with



- Organizing priorities, task lists, follow-ups, files, research, and weekly plans

 Tools you may work with

Bonus skills

-marketing strategy and execution, especially segmentation and automation

- Honest about what you know and what you need to learn

This is not the role for you if

- You confuse activity with progress.

- You use AI output without judgment, editing, or fact-checking.

- You watched a few videos about AI agents and now consider yourself an automation architect.



Hours and working style



This will begin part-time, with room to grow for the right person.

If you inherited six businesses with scattered files, ideas, content, and unfinished tasks, what would you do in your first week?

title: Video Editor and Brand Content Manager (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Company: Ryan Rivard / BSPKN Location: Remote, Philippines (metro area preferred) Type: Full-Time Compensation: $650 USD per month to start, with growth based on performance Start Date: Immediate, with a paid 2-week trial



ABOUT RYAN RIVARD



Ryan Rivard is an executive coach, endurance athlete, and content creator with 226,000 Instagram followers. He summited Mount Everest in May 2024, completed Ironman Madison and the Leadville 100 MTB, and coaches high-performing founders and executives through The Dodek Method. Ryan partners with leading performance and wellness brands. His content spans endurance training, mindset, brand partnerships, family, and recovery. We are looking for one strong person who can both edit high-quality video and manage the day-to-day content operation.



THE ROLE



This is a combined creative and operational role. You are responsible for turning raw footage into polished, scroll-stopping content and for keeping the content engine organized and consistent. This is not a passive posting job. You own the quality of what goes out and the rhythm of how it gets there.



The two halves of this role are equally important. If you are a brilliant editor but disorganized, this is not your role. If you are highly organized but cannot edit compelling video, this is not your role. We need both.



RESPONSIBILITIES



Edit 15 to 25 Instagram Reels per month from raw footage into polished, on-brand video with clean pacing, strong hooks, text overlays, captions, music, and transitions.

Produce both high-production brand partnership content and authentic, casual content, and know when each is appropriate.

Maintain consistent brand aesthetics across all static posts, carousels, and video. Colors, fonts, and style must match the brand guidelines every time.

Organize raw footage in Google Drive into the correct category folders as it comes in.

Build and maintain the weekly content calendar and keep posting consistent across Instagram, with TikTok and YouTube Shorts to follow.

Communicate proactively. Provide a clear weekly update on what is done, what is coming, and what you need.

Meet with Ryan once per week for a 30-minute sync to review what is working, what needs improvement, and priorities for the week ahead.



REQUIREMENTS



Minimum 2 years editing short-form video for Instagram Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts. Portfolio required.

Proficiency in a professional editing platform such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or CapCut Pro.

Strong design sense for maintaining consistent brand aesthetics across all content.

Excellent written English for captions and communication.

Highly organized, proactive, and reliable. You follow through without being chased.

Available during US Central Time with at least 3 hours of overlap daily, and available for a weekly 30-minute video call with Ryan.



HOW TO APPLY



Submit the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



Your portfolio or reel with at least 3 examples of short-form video you personally edited. This is required. We need to see real proof of your editing quality, pacing, and hooks.

One example of a branded or product-focused video you edited, so we can see how you handle brand content.

title: Recruitment Delivery Manager — US Direct-Hire Staffing — Night Shift, Remote
description:
US-based direct-hire staffing firm (healthcare/allied-health core, expanding into new verticals) is hiring a Recruitment Delivery Manager — a player-coach who owns our open-job board end-to-end and is accountable for filling it. Fully remote, Philippines-based, reporting directly to the founder.



This is not a sourcing-team or coordinator seat. You take the list of open US jobs, build the fill strategy for each one (sourcing channels, candidate pool, pay-band reality, timeline), personally recruit on the priority searches — sourcing, screening, and submitting candidates yourself — and build and coach a small delivery team as volume grows. You own the number: qualified submittals per week and jobs filled.



Responsibilities

- Own the open-req board: triage every US job, build a written per-req fill strategy, and keep every req moving or call it honestly.

- Personally work the priority desks full-cycle: source, screen (live phone/video), prep, and submit qualified candidates to US clients.

- Drive the delivery standard — quality-gated submittals per recruiter per week — with every candidate recruiter-screened before submission, no resume-blasting.

- Recruit, onboard, and coach delivery recruiters as the board requires; run the daily delivery cadence and report fill metrics weekly to the founder.

- Tell the truth with numbers: pipeline, submittals, interviews, offers, fills — measured, never estimated.



Required

- 4+ years US staffing/recruiting delivery experience, including 2+ years leading a delivery team that was measured on submittals and placements (not a sourcing-only or admin team). US healthcare staffing strongly preferred; allied health/imaging a major plus.

- Placements you personally closed — you can name specific placements you made (role, US state, salary) and walk through how you filled them. There WILL be a detailed walkthrough on the interview.

- Tenure that holds: at least one 24+ month run at a single staffing employer.

- Excellent spoken English — you screen candidates by phone and coach people who do; there will be a live spoken check.

- Fluent with an ATS and modern sourcing (job boards, LinkedIn, licensure/credential basics for US healthcare roles).

- Can work the fixed US night shift long-term with a reliable home setup (quiet room, headset, stable internet, backup power/data).



**Do NOT apply if:** your leadership experience is sourcing/CV-mining teams only (you've never owned submittals-to-fill); you've only coordinated VMS portals or onboarding paperwork; you cannot name specific placements you personally closed; your spoken English isn't strong enough to screen US healthcare professionals; or you can't commit to the fixed US night shift.



Why us: you run the whole delivery engine, not a slice of it — direct line to the founder, real authority over strategy and (as volume grows) your own team, competitive base plus a placement-linked bonus so your fills pay you, fully remote, long-term.



## APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. The delivery team you led: company, your title, team headcount, what the team was measured on, and its typical submittals + placements per month. What part did you personally still recruit on?

2. Name ONE placement you PERSONALLY closed in the last 2 years — job title, US state, salary, and how you found the candidate. *(Most important question — real specifics; we verify on the call.)*

3. Your longest single tenure at one staffing employer: company + number of months.

4. A US client gives you a hard-to-fill job: CT Technologist in Colorado, 9 candidates already submitted by others, none hired. In 4–6 sentences: your fill strategy, step by step.

5. Can you commit to a FIXED US night shift (~9:00 PM–6:00 AM PHT), Mon–Fri, long-term? (Yes/No + any constraint) And your home setup: internet speed, headset, quiet room, backup power/internet?

6. Current/most-recent monthly pay (PHP or USD), earliest start date, and a **30–60 sec voice intro** (link) introducing yourself as if opening a screening call with a US radiologic technologist.

title: Digital Marketing Executive Assistant To The CEO
description:
================

THE SHORT VERSION

================



You will work side by side with the CEO of an Inc. 5000 performance marketing agency, turning half-formed ideas into clear plans, organized projects, and finished work.



If you already understand how paid ads, funnels,
, and CRM workflows fit together, and you are the kind of person who moves projects forward without being chased, keep reading.



If you are looking for calendar management and inbox cleanup, this is not that job...



===================

ABOUT WRK MARKETING

===================



WRK Marketing is a performance marketing agency serving ecommerce and lead generation clients across the US. We build marketing systems, launch campaigns, improve funnels, manage paid traffic, produce creative, test offers, and grow revenue for our clients.



We move fast. Priorities shift. The work is real and it shifts too.



========================

WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO

========================



The CEO generates more ideas and priorities than any one person can execute. Your job is to catch them, structure them, and drive them to done.



In a typical week, you might:



- Take a rough concept from a voice note or a five-minute call and turn it into a scoped plan with owners, deadlines, and deliverables

- Build out and maintain projects in ClickUp, then keep them honest as things change

- Manage the agency's
 marketing calendar and coordinate the assets that feed it

- Push a funnel or landing page project forward across designers, copywriters, and media buyers

- Follow up with team members and contractors, surface what is stuck, and unblock it

- Research and evaluate a new tool, then write a short recommendation

- Clean up an internal workflow or document a process that only lives in someone's head

- Prep briefs, agendas, and materials so the CEO walks into every meeting ready



The mix changes based on what the business needs most that month. Flexibility is part of the job description.



======================

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

======================



FIRST 30 DAYS

You know our tools, our clients, our team, and our project structure. Nothing the CEO hands you gets dropped.

BY 90 DAYS

The CEO stops tracking status manually because you already know it. Projects have owners and dates. Follow-ups happen without reminders.

BY SIX MONTHS

You are catching problems before they surface and proposing solutions rather than waiting for direction. You own entire workstreams end to end.



=====================

WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

=====================



REAL DIGITAL MARKETING DEPTH

Not expert-level in everything, but you need to understand how the pieces connect: paid ads, funnels, landing pages,
 marketing, lead generation, ecommerce, CRM workflows, automation, reporting, creative strategy, and campaign planning. You should be able to sit in a strategy conversation and follow it without a glossary.

EXCELLENT WRITTEN & SPOKEN COMMUNICATION

You can write a clear update in four sentences. You can explain what is done, what is blocked, what needs a decision, and what happens next. You ask sharp questions instead of guessing.

GENUINE OWNERSHIP

You follow up with people who outrank you. You chase the thing you were told about three weeks ago. You do not go quiet.

COMFORT WITH SOFTWARE

You can open a platform you have never used, figure out what it does, and be productive in it quickly.

STRONG PLUSES

Agency experience. Project management experience. Team leadership experience. Direct experience supporting a CEO, founder, or senior executive.



======================

TOOLS YOU MIGHT TOUCH

======================



ClickUp, Slack, Google Workspace (Drive, Docs, Sheets), GoHighLevel or similar CRMs, Klaviyo and other
 platforms, funnel and landing page builders, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, Shopify, AgencyAnalytics or similar reporting dashboards, Canva, Figma, CapCut, and AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, Runway, Descript, and ElevenLabs.



Hands-on experience with ClickUp, Klaviyo, GoHighLevel, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and Shopify is a major advantage.



==========================

SCHEDULE, PAY, AND BENEFITS

==========================



- Full-time remote, Monday through Friday

- 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern Time, with a one-hour lunch (40 hours per week)

- $1,500/month to start, increasing to $2,500/month on successful completion of the 90-day probationary period

- 13th month pay after 6 months

- Paid holidays

- Flexible paid time off, approved in advance with the CEO

- Direct, daily access to the CEO of a growing Inc. 5000 agency

- A clear path into broader responsibility and ownership as you prove yourself



Please only apply if you can consistently work Eastern Time hours and the starting pay works for you.



==============

HOW TO APPLY

==============



Send all three of the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



1. YOUR RESUME

2. PROOF OF WORK

Portfolio, case studies, project examples, campaign results, or anything that shows what you have actually built or run.

3. A PERSONALIZED VIDEO INTRODUCTION, 2 TO 4 MINUTES



ABOUT THE VIDEO

Do not read from a script. We are not evaluating your polish, we are evaluating how you think and how you communicate. A phone camera or laptop camera in a quiet room is completely fine.



Cover these points:



- Your name and your digital marketing background

- Agency experience, if you have it

- Project management or leadership experience, if you have it

- The types of marketing projects you have personally helped manage or execute

- The tools and platforms you have worked in

- WHY SHOULD WE HIRE YOU?? PITCH YOURSELF.



================================

BEFORE YOU APPLY - PLEASE READ THIS

================================



This role asks for real commitment.



Most weeks are a normal 40 hours. Some are not. When a launch is live, a client deadline is on the line, or something breaks, there will be long days and the occasional weekend. We need someone who steps up in those moments instead of going quiet.



We are telling you this now because we would rather lose you today than in month three.



What you get in return is real. You will work directly with the CEO of a multi-million dollar performance marketing agency and see how the entire business actually runs: client strategy, sales, operations, hiring, and growth. That is an education you cannot buy, and it does not exist in a role where you are managing one channel for one brand.

title: Upwork Job Applicant
description:
Upwork Job Application & Lead Generation Virtual Assistant



Remote | Part-Time / Full-Time | OnlineJobs.ph



About the Role



I'm looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help manage job searching, opportunity research, and application submissions through Upwork.



This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable navigating Upwork, reviewing job descriptions, identifying strong opportunities, and submitting high-quality applications based on specific instructions.



The goal is to help streamline the application process and identify opportunities for clients looking for roles in areas such as:



Sales Development Representative (SDR)

Business Development Representative (BDR)

Lead Generation

Appointment Setting

Cold Calling

Sales Outreach

CRM Management

Other sales and business development roles

This is not just a "click and apply" position. You'll need to understand what makes an opportunity relevant, follow application instructions carefully, and help prioritize the best opportunities.



What You'll Be Doing



Your day-to-day responsibilities may include:



Searching Upwork for relevant job opportunities.

Reviewing job descriptions and requirements.

Identifying roles that match specific client experience and skill sets.

Applying to approved jobs on behalf of clients.

Writing or customizing application responses based on templates and instructions.

Tracking submitted applications.

Organizing job opportunities in a spreadsheet or tracking system.

Keeping track of responses, interviews, and follow-ups.

Identifying companies that may need help with SDR work, lead generation, appointment setting, or outbound sales.

Researching smaller companies that may not have established recruiting or sales systems.

Identifying opportunities where companies need help building or improving their prospecting process.

Helping organize application workflows so opportunities can be reviewed and submitted efficiently.

Understanding the Opportunity



Many of the companies posting on Upwork are smaller businesses or early-stage companies.



Some may not have a fully developed sales process. They may be looking for someone to:



Generate leads.

Build prospect lists.

Set up basic prospecting systems.

Conduct outbound outreach.

Book meetings.

Make cold calls.

Manage CRM activity.

Help build their sales development process from the ground up.

Your job will be to help identify these opportunities and determine which ones are worth applying to.



Some companies may have very clear job descriptions, while others may simply know that they need help generating leads or growing their business. Being able to understand what the company is actually looking for is important.



Upwork Experience Is Strongly Preferred



Because Upwork operates differently from traditional job boards, previous experience using the platform is strongly preferred.



You should understand:



How to search for relevant opportunities.

How to review job postings.

How to identify legitimate and worthwhile opportunities.

How the application process works.

How to track submitted proposals.

How to follow instructions carefully.

How to avoid duplicate applications.

How to manage application volume without sacrificing quality.

Some applications may require Connects, which are used to submit proposals on Upwork. Because of this, it's important that applications are submitted strategically and not wasted on poor-fit opportunities.



Additional Responsibilities



As the role grows, you may also help with:



Finding potential clients who need lead generation support.

Researching companies that are hiring SDRs, BDRs, appointment setters, or sales professionals.

Identifying businesses that may need help setting up outbound systems.

Tracking hiring trends and job opportunities.

Organizing client information.

Managing application pipelines.

Following up on submitted applications.

Assisting with onboarding and organizing new clients.

There may also be opportunities to help with other platforms and job boards in the future.



What I'm Looking For



I'm looking for someone who is:



Extremely detail-oriented.

Reliable and consistent.

Comfortable working independently.

Familiar with Upwork.

Good at reading and understanding job descriptions.

Able to follow specific instructions.

Organized and comfortable tracking multiple applications.

Comfortable working with spreadsheets and online tools.

Strong in written English.

Able to move quickly without becoming careless.

Comfortable asking questions when something is unclear.

Experience in any of the following is a major plus:



Upwork job applications

Lead generation

SDR or BDR work

Appointment setting

Recruiting

Sales prospecting

LinkedIn job searching

CRM management

Cold
 or outreach

Training and Process



You will not be expected to figure everything out on your own.



I will provide guidance on:



The types of jobs we are targeting.

Which opportunities should be prioritized.

What types of roles should be avoided.

How applications should be written.

What information should be included in proposals.

How to track applications.

How to identify a good-fit opportunity.

How to organize the overall workflow.

The goal is to create a repeatable system where we can efficiently find and apply to strong opportunities without sacrificing quality.



Important: This Role May Grow



This position will likely evolve over time.



As we build out the process, additional responsibilities, tools, and workflows may be introduced. I'm looking for someone who is comfortable adapting and learning as the business grows.



There may also be opportunities to take on additional clients and responsibilities depending on performance and workload.



To Apply



Please send me the following:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your previous experience using Upwork.

Examples of the types of jobs or clients you have helped apply for.

Your experience with lead generation, sales, recruiting, or job searching.

The tools and platforms you are comfortable using.

Your availability and preferred working hours.

Your expected hourly rate.

Bonus Question:



If you were given a client with SDR and BDR experience, what would you look for in an Upwork job posting before d
 whether it was worth applying to?



Please answer this question in your application. I'm looking for someone who can think critically about opportunities, not just submit applications blindly.

title: YouTube Video Editor – True Crime / IRL Documentary (Project-Based)
description:
I’m an actor, stand-up comedian, host, and content creator launching a new YouTube series called LaVelle LaRue LIVE.



The channel focuses on real-world investigations of notorious murders, disappearances, celebrity cases, organized crime stories, historic crime scenes, unsolved mysteries, and bizarre locations around Southern California.



The style I’m building is similar to fast-paced IRL documentary/investigation channels such as Tyler Oliveira, but with my own personality, acting, comedy, storytelling, and true-crime focus.



I am looking for a talented editor who understands YouTube retention and storytelling, not someone who simply cuts footage together.



This will start as project-based freelance work because the channel is new. If we work well together and the channel grows as planned, my goal is to turn this into consistent weekly work and eventually a full-time editing position.



What You’ll Edit



Typical videos will be approximately 10–25 minutes long and may include:



IRL investigation footage

interviews

livestream footage

voiceover

archival photos and video

news footage where legally usable

maps and location graphics

screenshots/documents

music and sound design

comedic moments

suspenseful storytelling

text and captions

B-roll

transitions between locations

occasional simple motion graphics



The finished video should feel like the viewer is inside the investigation with me, not watching a slow traditional documentary.



Editing Style I Need



You must understand how to create:



a strong first 30 seconds

fast pacing without making the video exhausting

visual changes that maintain attention

curiosity gaps

tension and escalation

story progression

clean interview edits

emotional/comedic reaction timing

B-roll placement

maps and location graphics

archive/photo sequences

music changes that support the story

sound effects when appropriate

clean color and audio

professional YouTube storytelling



Every 30–90 seconds should ideally introduce something new: a clue, location, person, fact, question, image, conflict, theory, or discovery.



Reference Style



Before applying, please watch this video so you understand the pacing and storytelling style I am looking for:



“I Investigated the Country Where Every Drug is Legal...” by Tyler Oliveira



You do NOT need to copy his graphics or personality. I want the pacing, field-documentary energy, storytelling, visual variety, and forward movement adapted to my true-crime investigation series.



Who I’m Looking For



You should:



have experience editing YouTube long-form content

understand audience retention

understand documentary/story editing

know how to find and organize B-roll

be comfortable working with a lot of raw footage

understand music and sound design

have strong English comprehension

communicate reliably

meet deadlines

accept feedback and revisions

care about storytelling



Premiere Pro is preferred. After Effects knowledge is a major plus.



Experience editing true crime, documentaries, IRL videos, journalism, travel videos, or investigative content is strongly preferred.



Starting Compensation



This position will begin per project, not as a full-time salary.



Initial range:



$100–$150 USD per completed long-form video, depending on length, complexity, experience, and quality.



Additional Shorts/Reels may be paid separately.



Rates can increase as the channel grows and as we develop a long-term working relationship.



There is strong potential for regular weekly work and eventually a full-time position for the right editor.



How To Apply



Please send:



Your name

Your location/time zone

Your editing software

2–5 examples of your BEST YouTube edits

Any documentary, true-crime, IRL, interview, or storytelling edits you have completed

How long you normally need to edit a 15-minute YouTube video

Your rate per finished 10–20 minute video

Your internet speed

Your computer specifications

Tell me what you think makes the Tyler Oliveira reference video hold attention



At the end of your application, write:



“LAVELLE LIVE”



so I know you actually read the entire job post.



Shortlisted editors may be offered a paid test edit before receiving a full project.



WAGE / SALARY



Enter:



$100–$150 per long-form video / Project Based



If the site forces you to use an hourly or monthly-looking format, put:



$5–$8/hour equivalent – Project Based



But in the description, keep the per-project rate as the real compensation structure.



I prefer per-project at this stage because it protects your cash flow and rewards editors who work efficiently.



I would not offer unpaid test edits.



For finalists, give them the same 2–3 minute section of raw footage and pay approximately:



$25–$40 for the test edit.



You'll learn much more from that than from portfolios.



DESIRED NUMBER OF HOURS PER WEEK



Put:



10



You're not promising ten hours every single week. You're communicating the approximate workload you're starting with.



Once you're producing heavily, we'll increase this substantially.



BUSINESS OR CONTACT NAME



Put:



LaVelle LaRue LIVE / Laugh Nation



That makes it look like they're joining a real media operation rather than doing random freelance work for an individual.



SKILLS REQUIREMENT



Search for and add the closest available choices to these, up to the site's maximum:



Video Editing

Adobe Premiere Pro

Adobe After Effects

YouTube

Motion Graphics

Audio Editing

Graphic Design

Social Media Video Editing

Storytelling

YouTube Video Editing



If "Storytelling" isn't available, replace it with something like Content Creation.



The three I care about most are:



Video Editing + Premiere Pro + YouTube



After Effects is valuable, but I would take an elite storyteller with basic graphics over an After Effects wizard who can't hold retention.



NOTIFICATION



Send all applicants to my
 address: 



At the beginning I want you to see everybody.



Once you start getting flooded, we can tighten the filtering process.

title: GoHighLevel Specialist — A2P/SMS Automation & Client Fulfillment
description:
MOAM Automation is a US-based AI automation agency serving home service businesses. We have a real, paying client whose SMS automation system needs fixing, and we need someone who already knows GoHighLevel deeply — not someone learning as they go.



This is NOT a general virtual assistant role. This is a specialist technical position.



YOUR FIRST TASK, IF HIRED: fix and stabilize the SMS automation system for our existing client (a barbershop) — reply follow-ups, appointment reminders, and review requests are not working correctly. You'll need to diagnose what's broken and fix it independently, using our documentation as a reference, not a full instruction manual.



If this first task goes well, there is real ongoing work: setting up new client accounts, A2P registration, and troubleshooting as we bring on more clients.



WHAT THIS ROLE REQUIRES:

- Real, hands-on GoHighLevel experience — you have personally built workflows, configured SMS automations, and registered A2P/10DLC brands for actual clients (not just watched tutorials)

- You understand that GHL's contact-level DND setting and carrier-level SMS opt-out (STOP replies) are two separate systems that must be checked independently

- You know GHL's Voi
 Drop feature requires MP3 audio, not M4A

- You can read an API error response and reason through what's actually wrong, rather than guessing

- Strong written English for async communication — most of our work will happen over messages, not calls



HOW TO APPLY — follow these steps exactly, or your application will not be reviewed:

1. In the subject line of your application, write: "MOAM-GHL-Fix"

2. Answer this directly in your message: "A client's SMS automation stops sending after a customer replies STOP. Days later, the client says the customer texted back and never got a reply. What are the two separate things you'd check, and why are they different?"

3. Share 1-2 examples of actual GoHighLevel work you've done — workflows, A2P registrations, or client builds. Screenshots or brief descriptions are fine.



Paid trial task first (~$50-100, scoped to the actual client issue) before any ongoing arrangement.

title: B2B Lead Generation & Cold Calling Specialist for Commercial Cleaning Company
description:
Part-Time Virtual Assistant – Lead Generation,
 Marketing & CRM



Kombat Solutions is a veteran-owned commercial cleaning company in the United States looking for a dependable, organized, and motivated Virtual Assistant to join our team part-time.



This position will start at approximately 12 hours per week, 3 days per week, 4 hours per day.



Main Responsibilities

B2B lead generation

Researching qualified commercial cleaning prospects

Finding decision-makers and accurate contact information


 marketing and cold
 outreach

Following up with prospects

Updating and organizing leads inside our CRM

Learning our sales process and helping keep the pipeline organized

Booking at least 3 qualified sales appointments/walkthrough opportunities per week

Performance Expectation



A major part of this role is helping generate real sales opportunities.



The VA will be expected to work toward a minimum of 3 qualified appointments per week with businesses that may need commercial cleaning or janitorial services.



Appointments should be with the appropriate decision-maker or someone directly involved in choosing or managing cleaning services.



Who We Are Looking For



We want someone who:



Has strong written and spoken English

Has experience with B2B lead generation

Understands cold
 and follow-up

Has appointment-setting experience

Is comfortable learning CRM systems

Is organized and follows instructions well

Can work independently

Is dependable and communicates clearly

Is willing to learn and grow with the company



Experience with tools such as Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, GoHighLevel, Hunter, Clay, ZoomInfo, Google Sheets, or similar platforms is a plus.



Commercial cleaning or B2B service experience is helpful but not required.



Schedule



Approximately 12 hours per week



3 days per week

4 hours per day

Must be available for some work during U.S. Eastern Time business hours

Pay



Starting pay: $3–$5 USD per hour, depending on experience and skill level.



There is potential for additional hours, increased responsibility, and long-term growth as the company grows and as you demonstrate strong performance.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction about yourself.

Your experience with B2B lead generation, appointment setting,
 marketing, and CRM systems.

The lead-generation tools you have used.

A 1–2 minute video with your camera on explaining your experience and why you believe you would be a good fit for this position.

Your current hourly rate.

Your availability in U.S. Eastern Time.

Briefly explain how you would approach booking at least 3 qualified appointments per week for a commercial cleaning company.



Please include the words “Kombat VA” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the full job post.



We are looking for someone who wants a long-term opportunity and is interested in growing with our company.

title: Part-Time VA for German Vacation Rental Business — Bookkeeping & File Organization (Async, Task-Based)
description:
Overview



I run a small vacation rental business in Germany with 6 apartments listed on Airbnb and Booking.com. I am looking for a reliable, detail-oriented VA to handle recurring administrative tasks.



Important — please read carefully:



This is a task-based position, not full-time

Currently around 6-10 hours per month

Work is asynchronous — you work in your normal Philippine daytime hours

One weekly 30-minute video call at 7:00 PM Manila time (please confirm this works for you)

Long-term stable position with potential to grow into more responsibility as trust develops



If you need full-time work immediately, this role is not for you (yet). If you have other small clients and want to add a reliable, low-drama recurring role to your portfolio, please read on.



Your Core Responsibilities



1. Booking documentation (bi-weekly, on the 15th and 1st of each month)



Log into Airbnb, Booking.com, and Smoobu (property management system)

Download all booking confirmations as PDFs for each new reservation

Download payout statements and platform commission invoices

Rename files following a strict naming convention (YYYYMMDD_Platform_GuestName.pdf)

Upload and organize in the correct Google Drive folder per business entity



2. Invoice generation (as needed, typically 2-5 per month)



Create formal VAT-compliant invoices for direct bookings and business travelers

Follow a provided template

Send to guest via

Archive in Google Drive



3. File organization



Maintain clean folder structure in Google Drive

Consistent naming conventions

Flag anything unclear for owner review

Must-Have Requirements

English: Very good written English (C1 level or better)

Airbnb experience: You have previously worked with Airbnb host accounts (co-host, VA, property manager, or your own listing)

Booking.com experience: You have used the Booking Extranet

Google Workspace: Comfortable with Google Drive, Sheets, and shared folders

Attention to detail: File naming, organizing, and consistency are your core skills

Reliability: You deliver on agreed deadlines. If something is delayed, you communicate proactively.

PDF handling: Can extract, rename, merge, and organize PDF files efficiently

Nice-to-Have (Bonus)

Smoobu experience (property management system I use)

Basic German reading skills (understanding invoice terms — you don't need to speak or write German)

Bookkeeping background

Experience with vacation rental / short-term rental businesses

Loom video creation

Bitwarden or other password manager experience

What You'll Get

Stable long-term recurring work at $7/hr

Payment via Wise (bi-weekly or monthly, your choice)

Task-based pay — no clock-watching, you get paid for delivered work at the agreed hourly rate

Clear SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) — no guessing what to do

Professional tools provided (password manager, Google Workspace access)

Growth opportunity: additional hours and responsibilities as trust develops

13th month bonus after 12 months of continuous work

What You Won't Get (Be Realistic)

This is not a full-time position (yet)

No guest communication in German (I handle that)

No access to financial accounts or payment methods

No unsupervised decisions on money-related matters

Working Style

Asynchronous: I hand over tasks in Germany evening (= your morning). You deliver during your normal working day. I review during my next Germany morning.

Two batch days per month: 15th and 1st for booking documentation (2-4 hours each, needs to be done that day)

Invoicing: within 24 hours of request

Weekly check-in call: 30 minutes at 7:00 PM Manila time (please confirm this works)

Response time: within 24 hours on weekdays for messages

Weekend work: not expected

Start Date



Immediately, after successful test task and interview



To Apply — REQUIRED (I will not respond to generic applications)



Please answer ALL of the following in your application. Applications missing any answer will be automatically rejected:



Airbnb experience: Describe the last Airbnb host account you worked on. What was your role? How many listings? For how long?

Booking.com Extranet: Have you personally used the Booking Extranet? If yes, what tasks did you handle (reservations, financial reports, messages)?

File organization example: Describe a file naming convention you have used for a previous client. Give an actual example filename.

Your other work situation: What other regular clients or jobs do you have? How does this role fit into your schedule?

English level: What is your self-assessed English level (A1-C2)? Have you taken any English tests (IELTS, TOEFL, EF-SET)? Score if you remember.

Weekly call availability: The weekly 30-min call would be at 7:00 PM Manila time on a weekday. Which day works best for you (Monday-Friday)?

Tools you know (list all that apply): Google Drive, Google Sheets, Airbnb Host, Booking Extranet, Smoobu, Hostaway, Guesty, PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Bitwarden, 1Password, LastPass, Loom, Slack, ClickUp, Notion, Asana

Process question: If I ask you to download all bookings from Airbnb for the month of March 2026 and save them in Google Drive with the naming convention "YYYYMMDD_Airbnb_GuestName.pdf", how would you approach this? Describe your process in 3-5 steps.



Bonus (not required, but appreciated): Please send a short (30-60 second) Loom video introducing yourself and explaining why you'd be a good fit. Link at the top of your application.



Thank you for reading the full posting! I look forward to hearing from qualified candidates.
